book_name: 会心之语·专八星火讲座答案词（2026决胜版）

words.tr: adj. 永恒的；永远的；长期有效的
words.ex: This song has a timeless melody.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌有着永恒的旋律。
words.en: If you describe something as timeless, you mean that it is so good or beautiful that it cannot be affected by changes in society or fashion.

words.tr: n. 结构；构造；
words.ex: The bridge has strong structures to support weight.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有坚固的结构来承受重量。
words.en: Structures refer to the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex. They can also denote buildings or other constructions standing as a whole.

words.tr: phrase. 空间与时间（物理学和哲学中描述宇宙基本维度的概念）
words.ex: Space and time are important in physics.
words.ex_cn: 空间和时间在物理学中很重要。
words.en: The concepts of space and time are central to our understanding of the physical universe, representing the dimensions in which all events occur.

words.tr: phrase. 基本方向； cardinal directions 指的是东、南、西、北四个主要方向
words.ex: He used the compass to find the cardinal directions.
words.ex_cn: 他用指南针找到四个基本方向。
words.en: The four main points of a compass: north, south, east, and west.

words.tr: phrase. 从左到右；自左向右
words.ex: He reads the numbers from left to right.
words.ex_cn: 他从左到右读数字。
words.en: Reading or writing from the left side to the right side.

words.tr: phrase. 相反的方向
words.ex: He walked in the opposite direction to avoid her.
words.ex_cn: 他朝相反的方向走，以避开她。
words.en: A direction that is completely contrary to another.

words.tr: v. 计算；清点；“count”的现在分词； n. 计算；
words.ex: He is counting the apples in the basket.
words.ex_cn: 他正在计算篮子里的苹果数量。
words.en: The action of finding the number of elements of a finite set of objects.

words.tr: phrase. 数字词；表示数字的单词（如 one, two, three 等）
words.ex: Children learn number words like one, two, and three in kindergarten.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在幼儿园学习像一、二、三这样的数字词。
words.en: Words used to express numbers, such as 'one', 'two', 'three'.

words.tr: n.边界
words.ex: The fence shows the boundaries of the yard.
words.ex_cn: 这道篱笆显示了院子的边界。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.tr: phrase. 深蓝色（的）
words.ex: He wears a dark blue shirt to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿一件深蓝色的衬衫。
words.en: A dark blue color is a deep shade of blue.

words.tr: phrase. 词语的性（指语法中名词或代词的性别分类，如阳性、阴性、中性）
words.ex: The gender of words matters in Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 词的性别在西班牙语中很重要。
words.en: The grammatical classification of nouns as masculine or feminine.

words.tr: phrase. 太阳（特指我们太阳系的恒星）
words.ex: The sun rises in the east.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起。
words.en: The star at the center of our solar system, providing light and heat to Earth; often personified in literature.

words.tr: adj. 男子气概的；
words.ex: He has a masculine voice and strong build.
words.ex_cn: 他声音低沉，身材强壮。
words.en: Having qualities or appearance traditionally associated with men.

words.tr: adj. 像男性的；有男性特征的
words.ex: He acts in a male-like way to seem strong.
words.ex_cn: 他表现得像男性一样，以显得强大。
words.en: Resembling or characteristic of a male.

words.tr: adj. 优雅的；
words.ex: She wore an elegant dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条优雅的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe a person or thing as elegant, you mean that they are pleasing and graceful in appearance or style.

words.tr: phrase. 说西班牙语的人；西班牙语使用者
words.ex: Spanish speakers live in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 西班牙语使用者生活在许多国家。
words.en: People whose native language is Spanish.

words.tr: phrase. 广泛的影响；广泛的效应
words.ex: The policy has broad effects on daily life.
words.ex_cn: 这项政策对日常生活有广泛的影响。
words.en: Wide-ranging or significant consequences.

words.tr: adv. 下意识地；本能地；
words.ex: She instinctively reached for her phone when it rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响时，她下意识地伸手去拿手机。
words.en: If you behave instinctively, you do something without thinking about it because it seems natural or the right thing to do.

words.tr: phrase. 一直；总是
words.ex: He is talking all the time.
words.ex_cn: 他一直在说话。
words.en: If something happens or is done all the time, it happens or is done continually or repeatedly.

words.tr: adv. 连续地；不断地；连续不断地；
words.ex: The machine works continuously without stopping.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器连续工作，不停止。
words.en: Without interruption; constantly.

words.tr: adj. 普遍的；全体的；
words.ex: This rule is universal for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则对所有学生都是普遍适用的。
words.en: Something that is universal affects or relates to every part of the world or the universe.

words.tr: phrase. 身体动作；躯体运动
words.ex: He controls his body movement carefully in dance class.
words.ex_cn: 他在舞蹈课上仔细控制自己的身体动作。
words.en: The act of moving the body or parts of the body.

words.tr: v. 招手示意；举手召唤；引诱
words.ex: He beckoned to the boy to come closer.
words.ex_cn: 他向那个男孩招手示意过来。
words.en: If you beckon to someone, you signal to them to come to you, usually by a gesture of your hand.

words.tr: phrase. 说英语的国家
words.ex: He moved to an English-speaking country last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年搬到了一个英语国家。
words.en: Countries where English is the primary language spoken by the majority of the population.

words.tr: phrase. 对话的流程；交谈的进行过程
words.ex: The flow of conversation was smooth and natural.
words.ex_cn: 对话的流畅自然。
words.en: The progression or movement of dialogue between people.

words.tr:
n. 触摸；触觉；触感；
v. 触摸；接触；触动；
words.ex: The touch of her hand was gentle.
words.ex_cn: 她手的触摸很温柔。
words.en: If you touch something, you feel it with your hand, or come into physical contact with it.

words.tr: phrase. 关系的亲密程度；人际亲近度
words.ex: The relationship closeness between them grew stronger over time.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的关系亲密程度随着时间推移而加深。
words.en: The state of being emotionally close and intimately connected with another person.

words.tr: phrase. 语气和语调；指说话时声音的高低变化与情感色彩
words.ex: She changed her tone and inflection to sound friendly.
words.ex_cn: 她改变了语气和语调，听起来更友好。
words.en: The pitch and intonation of speech, indicating emotion or emphasis.

words.tr: v. 捏造；假装……的样子（fake 的过去式、过去分词）；
words.ex: He faked a letter to trick his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他捏造了一封信来欺骗他的老板。
words.en: Made to look like something else, especially in order to deceive.

words.tr: phrase. 声称拥有控制权； assert：宣称，坚持；domination：支配，控制
words.ex: He asserts domination over the team during meetings.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议中声称拥有对团队的控制权。
words.en: To establish or demonstrate control or superiority over others.

words.tr: phrase. /prep. 负责；主管；掌管
words.ex: He is in charge of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他负责管理教室。
words.en: Having the responsibility for something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 非语言线索；非言语暗示（如面部表情、手势、姿态、眼神等）
words.ex: He read the nonverbal cues to understand her feelings.
words.ex_cn: 他通过观察非语言线索来理解她的情绪。
words.en: Nonverbal cues are signals used to communicate without words, including facial expressions, body language, gestures, and tone of voice.

words.tr: phrase. 轻轻用脚打拍子；用脚轻敲（常指随音乐节奏）
words.ex: He is tapping his feet to the music.
words.ex_cn: 他正随着音乐 tapping your feet。
words.en: Rhythmic movement of feet to music or as a sign of impatience.

words.tr: phrase. 一种开放的站姿，常用于运动中，指双脚分开、身体侧向的姿势
words.ex: The tennis player took an open stance before serving.
words.ex_cn: 网球运动员在发球前摆出了开放的站姿。
words.en: A relaxed, non-defensive posture, often open and approachable.

words.tr: phrase. 发音；声音的读音；语音的发音方式
words.ex: He practices the pronunciation of sounds every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习发音。
words.en: The act or manner of pronouncing sounds; the articulation of speech sounds.

words.tr: n. 方式；举止；
words.ex: He spoke in a polite manner.
words.ex_cn: 他以礼貌的方式说话。
words.en: The way in which something is done or happens.

words.tr: n. 原则；原理；“principle”的复数；
words.ex: He always follows the principles of honesty and fairness.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遵循诚实和公平的原则。
words.en: A principle is a general belief that you have about the way you should behave, which influences your behavior.

words.tr:
n. 语音学
adj. 语音的；发音的
words.ex: He is learning phonetics to improve his pronunciation.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习语音学以改善发音。
words.en: Phonetics is the study of the sounds of human speech.

words.tr: phrase. 浊音的或清音的（用于描述发音时声带是否振动）
words.ex: The letter 'b' is a voiced sound, but 'p' is unvoiced.
words.ex_cn: 字母 'b' 是浊音，而 'p' 是清音。
words.en: Referring to sounds produced with or without vibration of the vocal cords.

words.tr: phrase. 单数形式（指语法中表示单个事物或人的词形）
words.ex: The singular form of 'cats' is 'cat'.
words.ex_cn: “cats”的单数形式是“cat”。
words.en: The grammatical form of a noun or verb referring to one person or thing.

words.tr: n. 成分；选民；选民( constituent的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The constituents of this drink are water, sugar, and lemon.
words.ex_cn: 这种饮料的成分是水、糖和柠檬。
words.en: A constituent is a part of a whole, especially a part of a country, state, or organization that elects representatives to a legislative body.

words.tr: n. 语法
words.ex: He is learning English grammar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在学习英语语法。
words.en: Grammar is the system and structure of a language. The rules of grammar help us decide the order we put words in and which form of a word to use.

words.tr: phrase. 语言的使用；语言运用方式
words.ex: The usage of language helps people communicate.
words.ex_cn: 语言的使用帮助人们交流。
words.en: The way words are used and combined in a particular language or context.

words.tr: phrase. 语言的用途；语言的功能；语言的使用方式
words.ex: He learns the uses of language to talk with others.
words.ex_cn: 他学习语言的用途来与他人交流。
words.en: The ways in which language is employed for various purposes, such as communication, expression, and social interaction.

words.tr: phrase. 社会背景；社会环境；指影响个体行为或事件发生的社会条件与环境
words.ex: The child's behavior makes sense in its social context.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子的行为在它的社会环境中是有道理的。
words.en: The social context refers to the immediate physical and social setting in which people live or in which something happens or develops. It includes the culture that the individual was educated or lives in, and the people and institutions with whom they interact.

words.tr: phrase. 受教育程度；教育水平；学历层次
words.ex: His level of education is high school.
words.ex_cn: 他的教育水平是高中。
words.en: The stage or standard of education that an individual has achieved.

words.tr: n. 文本；
words.ex: He read the texts before the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课前读了这些文本。
words.en: Texts are written or printed materials that provide information or serve as a basis for discussion, study, or performance.

words.tr: phrase. 随意的开始；非正式的开端
words.ex: He made a casual start to the day by drinking coffee in pajamas.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着睡衣喝咖啡，随意地开始了这一天。
words.en: An informal or relaxed beginning to a conversation or interaction.

words.tr: phrase. 结构松散的；组织不严谨的
words.ex: The meeting was loosely structured, so people talked freely.
words.ex_cn: 会议结构松散，所以人们自由交谈。
words.en: Describes something that is not tightly organized or rigidly arranged, allowing for flexibility and adaptability.

words.tr: phrase. 语言标记；语言学指标；用于标示语言特征或变异的符号或形式
words.ex: He used linguistic markers to show his emotion.
words.ex_cn: 他使用语言标记来表达他的情绪。
words.en: Linguistic markers are elements of language that indicate specific social, cultural, or personal characteristics of the speaker.

words.tr: adv. 有益地；
words.ex: He sold his old car profitably.
words.ex_cn: 他以有利的方式卖掉了他的旧车。
words.en: In a way that results in or is likely to result in a profit or benefit.

words.tr: adv. 有用地；
words.ex: She arranged the books usefully on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 她把书有用地摆放在书架上。
words.en: In a way that is beneficial or advantageous.

words.tr: n. 智力；情报；
words.ex: He shows high intelligence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很高的智力。
words.en: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.

words.tr: n. 科学
words.ex: He loves science and reads books about it.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢科学，经常读关于它的书。
words.en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

words.tr: adj. 自然的；天然的；
words.ex: The children played in the natural park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在自然公园里玩耍。
words.en: Existing in or caused by nature; not made or caused by humankind.

words.tr: n. 好奇心
words.ex: The child's curiosity made him ask many questions.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的好奇心让他问了很多问题。
words.en: A desire to know or learn about something; something that is interesting because it is unusual or strange.

words.tr: phrase. 物质世界；物理世界（指由物质和能量构成的现实世界，区别于精神或抽象世界）
words.ex: Science helps us understand the physical world.
words.ex_cn: 科学帮助我们理解物质世界。
words.en: The physical world refers to the material universe and all its phenomena, as distinguished from the spiritual world or from ideas.

words.tr: pron. 我们自己
words.ex: We cleaned the house ourselves.
words.ex_cn: 我们自己打扫了房子。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition when this is the same as the subject of the clause and the subject is the speaker and one or more other people considered together.

words.tr: n. 宗教
words.ex: He practices his religion every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都实践自己的宗教信仰。
words.en: Religion is the belief in and worship of a superhuman controlling power, especially a personal God or gods.

words.tr: n. 事实；真理；真实；
words.ex: The truth is that he was late for work.
words.ex_cn: 事实是他上班迟到了。
words.en: The truth is the true facts about something, rather than what is imagined or invented.

words.tr: v. 创造；创作；
words.ex: He is creating a new painting.
words.ex_cn: 他正在创作一幅新画。
words.en: To bring something into existence.

words.tr: n. 语言
words.ex: He speaks English as his first language.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语作为他的第一语言。
words.en: Language is the system of communication in speech and writing that is used by people of a particular country or area.

words.tr: adj. 永恒的；永远的；长期有效的
words.ex: This song has a timeless melody.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌有着永恒的旋律。
words.en: If you describe something as timeless, you mean that it is so good or beautiful that it cannot be affected by changes in society or fashion.

words.tr: phrase. 敬畏与尊敬；对某人或某事物怀有的既敬畏又尊重的深厚情感
words.ex: They felt awe and reverence in the old church.
words.ex_cn: 他们在古老的教堂里感到敬畏。
words.en: A feeling of respect mixed with fear or wonder.

words.tr: n. 意思；意义； v. 表示…的意思；意思；“mean”的现在分词；
words.ex: What is the meaning of this word?
words.ex_cn: 这个词的意思是什么？
words.en: The meaning of something is what it expresses or represents.

words.tr: n. 建议；推荐；“recommendation”的复数；
words.ex: The doctor gave me some health recommendations.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我一些健康建议。
words.en: Recommendations are suggestions or proposals about the best course of action to take, especially those given by someone in authority or with expertise.

words.tr: adj. 陷入困境的；受到限制的； v. 设圈套；陷入（困境）；“trap”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The hikers were trapped in the snowstorm.
words.ex_cn: 这些徒步者被困在暴风雪中。
words.en: If you feel trapped, you are in a situation that you cannot easily get out of.

words.tr: phrase. 完全陌生的人
words.ex: He talked to a complete stranger on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上和一个完全陌生的人聊天。
words.en: A person whom one does not know at all.

words.tr: phrase. 一个胜利者；成功的人或事物
words.ex: He is a winner of the race.
words.ex_cn: 他是这场比赛的赢家。
words.en: A person or thing that achieves victory or success.

words.tr: phrase. 表示反对或否定的决定（通常以拇指朝下手势象征）
words.ex: The judge made the thumbs-down decision to cancel the game.
words.ex_cn: 法官做出了取消比赛的否决决定。
words.en: A decision to reject or refuse something, often indicated by a thumbs-down gesture.

words.tr: n. （动物）梳毛； v. “groom”的现在分词；
words.ex: The cat spends hours on grooming its fur.
words.ex_cn: 猫花几个小时梳理自己的毛。
words.en: The activity of keeping yourself or your pet clean and tidy, especially by washing, brushing, and cutting hair.

words.tr: adj. 处于准备状态的； v. “poise”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The athlete is poised to jump.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员准备好了要跳。
words.en: If someone is poised, they are calm, dignified, and self-controlled, especially in a difficult situation.

words.tr: phrase. 闲聊；寒暄；无关紧要的谈话
words.ex: He makes small talk with his neighbors every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上和邻居闲聊。
words.en: Small talk is polite conversation about unimportant or uncontroversial matters, especially as engaged in on social occasions.

words.tr: n.自我介绍
words.ex: He gave a short self-introduction at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上做了简短的自我介绍。
words.en: An act of introducing oneself, typically at the beginning of a meeting or event.

words.tr: phrase. 工作经验；职业经历
words.ex: He has work experience in a restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 他在餐厅有工作经验。
words.en: Work experience refers to the knowledge and skills that someone has gained through working in a particular job or field.

words.tr: phrase. 一个缺陷；瑕疵；缺点
words.ex: There is a flaw in the design.
words.ex_cn: 这个设计有一个缺陷。
words.en: A weakness or imperfection in a system, argument, or object.

words.tr: phrase. 推销自己；展示自己的优势以获得认可或机会
words.ex: He needs to sell himself in the job interview.
words.ex_cn: 他需要在面试中推销自己。
words.en: To promote or present oneself positively, especially in a professional context.

words.tr: phrase. 薪资与休假（指员工薪酬及带薪假期的统称）
words.ex: The company offers good pay and vacation to all employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为所有员工提供良好的薪资与休假。
words.en: Payment and time off from work, often as part of an employment package.

words.tr: phrase. 给面试官留下深刻印象
words.ex: She answered all the questions well to impress the interviewer.
words.ex_cn: 她很好地回答了所有问题，以给面试官留下深刻印象。
words.en: Make a positive and memorable impression on a person conducting a job interview.

words.tr: phrase. 表达你的感谢
words.ex: You should express your thanks to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 你应该向老师表达你的感谢。
words.en: Communicate gratitude or appreciation verbally or in writing.

words.tr:
adj. 简短的；简明的；短暂的；
v. 为…提供信息；
n. 摘要；概要；
words.ex: He gave a brief answer.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个简短的答案。
words.en: If something is brief, it lasts only for a short time.

words.tr: adj. 缺乏创造性的；
words.ex: His painting is uncreative and boring.
words.ex_cn: 他的画缺乏创造性，很无聊。
words.en: Lacking originality or imagination; not creative.

words.tr: phrase. 基本技能；基础能力
words.ex: He practices basic skills every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习基本技能。
words.en: The fundamental skills required to perform a task or activity.

words.tr: n. 出席；
words.ex: His attendance at the meeting was mandatory.
words.ex_cn: 他必须出席这次会议。
words.en: The act of being present at a place or event.

words.tr: n. 准备；预备；
words.ex: The preparation for the exam took two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 考试的准备花了两周时间。
words.en: Preparation is the process of getting something ready for use or for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adv. 聪明地；有智慧地
words.ex: He solved the puzzle intelligently.
words.ex_cn: 他聪明地解决了这个谜题。
words.en: In a way that shows intelligence or good judgment.

words.tr: v. 想入非非，空想( daydream的现在分词 )
words.ex: He is daydreaming during math class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在数学课上做白日梦。
words.en: Daydreaming is the act of thinking about pleasant things that you would like to happen, or about things that you would like to do, while you are awake.

words.tr: v. 预料；预期；
words.ex: I anticipate rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我预料明天会下雨。
words.en: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

words.tr: phrase. 讨论课；研讨班（通常指以学生讨论为主的小班教学形式）
words.ex: We have discussion classes every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周五都有讨论课。
words.en: Academic sessions where students engage in conversation and debate on a topic.

words.tr: n. 反馈
words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.tr: phrase. 问题与意见；提问与评论
words.ex: He wrote down the questions and comments after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议后记下了问题和评论。
words.en: Inquiries and remarks made during a conversation or presentation.

words.tr: v. 继续；连续；“continue”的现在分词； adj. 连续的；持续的；继续的；
words.ex: He is continuing his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后继续做作业。
words.en: adjective. Continuing is used to describe something that keeps happening or existing without stopping.

words.tr: n. 管理员；“administrator”的复数；
words.ex: The administrators fixed the website error.
words.ex_cn: 管理员修复了网站的错误。
words.en: Administrators are people whose job is to manage and organize the affairs of a business or institution.

words.tr: phrase. 无法抗拒的论坛；极具吸引力的讨论场所
words.ex: The online debate became an irresistible forum for young thinkers.
words.ex_cn: 这个在线辩论成为年轻思想者无法抗拒的论坛。
words.en: An irresistible forum refers to a platform or place for discussion that is so appealing or compelling that one cannot resist participating in it.

words.tr: phrase. 更小的班级（指学生人数较少的课堂）
words.ex: Smaller classes help students learn better.
words.ex_cn: 小班教学有助于学生更好地学习。
words.en: Smaller classes refer to educational settings where the number of students per class is reduced to enhance learning outcomes.

words.tr: n. 承诺；奉献；
words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

words.tr: phrase. 语言习得
words.ex: Children learn language acquisition naturally through listening and speaking.
words.ex_cn: 儿童通过听和说自然地进行语言习得。
words.en: The process by which humans acquire the capacity to perceive and comprehend language, as well as to produce and use words and sentences to communicate.

words.tr: phrase. 语言出现；言语萌发（指语言能力开始显现或发展的阶段）
words.ex: The child's speech emergence was slow but steady.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的语言表达出现得较慢但很稳定。
words.en: The stage in language development where a learner begins to produce speech spontaneously and with increasing complexity.

words.tr: phrase. 基于内容的教学（一种将语言教学与学科知识相结合的教学方法）
words.ex: The teacher uses content-based teaching to help students learn English through science topics.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用内容型教学，通过科学主题帮助学生学习英语。
words.en: Content-based teaching is an approach to language education that emphasizes learning a language through the study of content from other subject areas. It integrates language learning with subject matter learning, making the language more meaningful and relevant to students.

words.tr: adj．基于主题的：以特定主题为基础的，通常用于描述课程、活动、项目等。
words.ex: The school has a theme-based learning program.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个以主题为基础的学习项目。
words.en: adjective. Organized around a particular subject or theme.

words.tr: phrase. 学习活动；教学活动
words.ex: The teacher plans fun learning activities for the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师为学生们安排了有趣的教学活动。
words.en: Activities designed to facilitate learning and the acquisition of knowledge or skills.

words.tr: phrase. 语言重点；语言焦点（指在教学中对特定语言形式或功能的集中关注）
words.ex: The teacher has a language focus on grammar and vocabulary.
words.ex_cn: 老师专注于语法和词汇。
words.en: A section in a language course or textbook that concentrates on specific grammatical rules, vocabulary, or communication skills.

words.tr: phrase. 交际意图；交流目的
words.ex: He showed his communicative intent by asking clear questions.
words.ex_cn: 他通过提出清晰的问题表达了交流的意图。
words.en: The purpose or goal behind a communication act, aiming to convey a message or information to others.

words.tr: phrase. 以小组形式；分小组地
words.ex: The children work in small groups to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们分成小组来解决这个谜题。
words.en: In small groups refers to the manner of organizing people or activities into smaller, more manageable units for discussion, work, or study.

words.tr: v. 促进( facilitate的第三人称单数 ); 使便利; 推进; 帮助（某人）进步
words.ex: The app facilitates learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用程序有助于学习英语。
words.en: Makes an action or process easier or more feasible.

words.tr: v. （使）成长；发展；（使）发育；
words.ex: The plant develops quickly in sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物在阳光下迅速成长。
words.en: If you develop something, you make it grow, change, or become more advanced.

words.tr: phrase. 四项技能（通常指听、说、读、写四项语言技能）
words.ex: He practices the four skills every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习四项技能。
words.en: The core language abilities: listening, speaking, reading, and writing.

words.tr: phrase. 学生的需求（复数所有格形式，指多个学生的需要或要求）
words.ex: The teacher meets students' needs by giving extra help.
words.ex_cn: 老师通过提供额外帮助来满足学生的需求。
words.en: The specific requirements or preferences of learners that a teacher or course should address.

words.tr: phrase. 认知能力；指个体接收、处理、存储和应用信息的心理能力
words.ex: Children develop cognitive ability as they grow older.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们随着年龄增长发展认知能力。
words.en: Cognitive ability refers to the mental processes that enable us to carry out any task that requires thought, including perception, memory, judgment, and reasoning.

words.tr: 这些学生的（所有格形式，表示所属关系）
words.ex: The students' books are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 这些学生的书在桌子上。
words.en: The possessive form of 'the students', indicating that something belongs to the students.

words.tr: phrase. 学习者的需求
words.ex: Teachers must meet learners' needs.
words.ex_cn: 教师必须满足学习者的需求。
words.en: The specific requirements and goals of people who are learning a subject or skill.

words.tr: n. 语法
words.ex: He is learning English grammar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在学习英语语法。
words.en: Grammar is the system and structure of a language. The rules of grammar help us decide the order we put words in and which form of a word to use.

words.tr: phrase. 组织策划：指对事物进行有条理地安排和计划，以达到特定的目标。
words.ex: They organize and plan the party every year.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年都会组织和计划这个派对。
words.en: Arrange and prepare activities or tasks in a systematic way.

words.tr: phrase. 月历；月度日历；按月编排的日历
words.ex: He hangs a monthly calendar on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把月历挂在墙上。
words.en: A monthly calendar is a chart or series of pages showing the days, weeks, and months of a particular year, used to keep track of dates and events.

words.tr: phrase. 学习计划；学习规划
words.ex: He makes study plans every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周制定学习计划。
words.en: A study plan is a detailed schedule outlining study times and learning goals.

words.tr: phrase. 固定的工作时间；规定的时间段
words.ex: He works fixed hours from 9 to 5.
words.ex_cn: 他每天固定从九点工作到五点。
words.en: Regular working hours that do not change.

words.tr: phrase. 休息与放松；休整；休闲
words.ex: He needs rest and relaxation after work.
words.ex_cn: 他工作后需要休息和放松。
words.en: Rest and relaxation refer to a period of time spent not working or being active, in order to recover one's health or strength.

words.tr: phrase. 待办事项清单；需完成的任务列表
words.ex: I wrote my tasks on a to-do list.
words.ex_cn: 我把我的任务写在待办事项清单上。
words.en: A list of tasks that need to be completed, often used to organize one's work or daily activities.

words.tr: n. 事实；“fact”的复数；
words.ex: The facts show that he was not at the scene.
words.ex_cn: 事实表明他当时不在现场。
words.en: A fact is a piece of information that is known to be true.

words.tr: phrase. 重要性的信号；表示重要性的迹象或征兆
words.ex: The dark clouds are signals of importance for the coming storm.
words.ex_cn: 乌云是即将来临风暴的重要信号。
words.en: Indicators or cues that highlight the most important points in a text or speech.

words.tr: n. 例子；“example”的复数
words.ex: He shows examples of good writing.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了优秀写作的例子。
words.en: Instances or samples that illustrate a point, demonstrate a concept, or serve as models.

words.tr: phrase. 书面记录；文字记载
words.ex: He kept a written record of his daily expenses.
words.ex_cn: 他记录了每天的开销。
words.en: A document or note that provides evidence or a summary of events or information.

words.tr: phrase. 鸟瞰；俯视；全局视角
words.ex: From the top of the hill, we had a bird's-eye view of the town.
words.ex_cn: 从山顶上，我们俯瞰了整个城镇。
words.en: A bird's-eye view is a view from a high angle as if seen by a bird in flight, offering a wide perspective on an area or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 隐瞒重要信息无中文释义
words.ex: The worker used a tarp to shade important material from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 工人用防水布遮蔽重要材料，以免阳光直射。
words.en: A summary or abstract of important material, often highlighting key points.

words.tr: phrase. 寻找线索；搜寻蛛丝马迹
words.ex: He is looking for clues in the old diary.
words.ex_cn: 他正在旧日记里寻找线索。
words.en: The act of searching for hints or evidence to solve a problem or mystery.

words.tr: phrase. 提纲格式；概要形式；轮廓样式
words.ex: He wrote the report in outline form.
words.ex_cn: 他用提纲形式写了这份报告。
words.en: A preliminary or skeletal version of a document or plan, showing main points.

words.tr: v. 重复；“repeat”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 重复的；反复发生的；
words.ex: He repeated the words after the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他跟着老师重复了这些话。
words.en: Something that is repeated happens or is done more than once.

words.tr: adj. 文化的
words.ex: They learned about cultural traditions during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在旅行中了解了文化传统。
words.en: Relating to the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a society.

words.tr: phrase. 第一个罪；原罪（常指基督教中亚当和夏娃所犯的罪）
words.ex: Adam committed the first sin in the Garden of Eden.
words.ex_cn: 亚当在伊甸园里犯了第一桩罪。
words.en: In Christian theology, the first sin refers to the original sin, which is the state of sin into which all humans are born as a result of Adam and Eve's disobedience in the Garden of Eden.

words.tr: n. 肌肉；权力；影响力；
words.ex: He strengthened his muscle by lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他通过举重来增强肌肉。
words.en: Muscle is the tissue in the body that can contract to produce movement or maintain the position of parts of the body.

words.tr:
n. 脂肪；
adj. 肥的；
words.ex: This food has too much fat.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物含有太多脂肪。
words.en: Fat is a substance contained in foods such as meat, cheese, and butter, which is used by the body to produce energy or stored in the body as a layer.

words.tr: n. 智力；情报；
words.ex: He shows high intelligence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很高的智力。
words.en: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.

words.tr: n. 划分；部门；
words.ex: The division of the cake was fair.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的划分是公平的。
words.en: The act or process of dividing something into parts or the state of being divided.

words.tr: adj. （男性）家长制的；族长制的；父权制的
words.ex: He lives in a patriarchal family where the father makes all the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他生活在一个父亲做所有决定的父权家庭中。
words.en: Relating to, characteristic of, or denoting a system of society or government controlled by men.

words.tr: n.权利
words.ex: Everyone has the right to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有自由发言的权利。
words.en: Rights are legal, social, or ethical principles of freedom or entitlement; that is, rights are the fundamental normative rules about what is allowed of people or owed to people, according to some legal system, social convention, or ethical theory.

words.tr: n. 儿童托管；儿童保育；
words.ex: She works in childcare for young children.
words.ex_cn: 她从事幼儿托管工作。
words.en: The care of children, especially by a service or organization.

words.tr: adj.低薪的; 低报酬的
words.ex: He works at a low-paying job to gain experience.
words.ex_cn: 他做一份低薪的工作以积累经验。
words.en: A low-paying job is one that does not pay much money.

words.tr: phrase. 经济的或职业的
words.ex: He changed his economic or occupational path after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后改变了经济或职业道路。
words.en: Relating to finance, trade, or the nature of one's job or profession.

words.tr: adj. 心理的；心理学的；
words.ex: He felt psychological stress before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到心理压力。
words.en: Relating to the mental and emotional state of a person.

words.tr: adj. 决定性的；
words.ex: His decisive action saved the team.
words.ex_cn: 他果断的行动拯救了团队。
words.en: If a fact, action, or event is decisive, it makes it certain that there will be a particular result.

words.tr: adj. 服从的；顺从的；
words.ex: The obedient child cleaned his room without being told.
words.ex_cn: 这个听话的孩子没被要求就打扫了房间。
words.en: An obedient person or animal does what they are told to do.

words.tr: adv. 轻柔地；温和地；柔和地；
words.ex: She spoke softly to the baby.
words.ex_cn: 她轻柔地对婴儿说话。
words.en: In a gentle, quiet, or delicate manner.

words.tr: adj. 神秘的
words.ex: The mysterious box appeared on his doorstep.
words.ex_cn: 那个神秘的盒子出现在他的门口。
words.en: If someone or something is mysterious, it is not fully understood or explained and seems interesting or puzzling.

words.tr: v. 读；阅读；
words.ex: I read a book every night.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上读书。
words.en: To look at and comprehend the meaning of written or printed matter by interpreting the characters or symbols of which it is composed.

words.tr:
adj. 文盲的；无知的；
n. 文盲；无知识的人；
words.ex: He is illiterate and cannot read simple signs.
words.ex_cn: 他是文盲，无法阅读简单的标识。
words.en: Someone who is illiterate cannot read or write.

words.tr: phrase. 试探性地询问；逐字拼读；探询意见
words.ex: He sounds out his boss about a raise.
words.ex_cn: 他试探性地向老板询问加薪的事。
words.en: To try to find out someone's opinions, intentions, or feelings about something, especially by asking them carefully and indirectly.

words.tr: phrase. 现代希腊语（指自19世纪至今使用的希腊语形式）
words.ex: He speaks modern Greek at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家说现代希腊语。
words.en: Modern Greek refers to the Greek language as spoken and written in the modern era, from the late Byzantine period to the present day.

words.tr: phrase. 书面材料；文字资料
words.ex: The teacher gave us written materials for the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们考试的书面材料。
words.en: Documents, texts, or data used for reference, study, or information.

words.tr: phrase. 暴露的；处于易受攻击或影响的状态
words.ex: The children were being exposed to the cold wind.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正暴露在寒风中。
words.en: If someone is exposed to something, they are put in a situation where it might affect them, often in a harmful way.

words.tr: adj. 发展的；进化的；
words.ex: This program supports developmental milestones in children.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目支持儿童的发展阶段。
words.en: Developmental is an adjective that describes something related to the growth or development of someone or something.

words.tr: v. 吸收；“assimilate”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The child assimilated new words quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子很快吸收了新单词。
words.en: If you assimilate new ideas, techniques, or information, you learn them or adopt them.

words.tr: n. 规则的例外；例外的事物；例外( exception的名词复数 )；
words.ex: There are exceptions to every rule.
words.ex_cn: 每条规则都有例外。
words.en: An exception is something that is not included in a general statement or does not follow a rule or pattern.

words.tr: 由……引导；在……的指引下
words.ex: He is guided by his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他受到老师的指导。
words.en: Directed or influenced by a particular principle, person, or method.

words.tr: phrase. 全局意义；整体含义
words.ex: The global meaning of peace is important to all countries.
words.ex_cn: 和平的全球意义对所有国家都很重要。
words.en: The overall or principal significance of a text, concept, or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 并列的句子；放在一起的句子
words.ex: The teacher wrote two sentences placed together on the board.
words.ex_cn: 老师在黑板上写下了两个并列的句子。
words.en: A sequence of clauses or phrases that form a coherent unit of meaning.

words.tr: n. 终结；定局；不可改变性
words.ex: The finality of his decision surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他决定的终结让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: the fact or impression of being final and irreversible

words.tr: n. <语>代词( pronoun的名词复数 )
words.ex: He learns pronouns like 'I', 'you', and 'they' in English class.
words.ex_cn: 他在英语课上学习像‘我’、‘你’和‘他们’这样的代词。
words.en: Pronouns are words that are used to replace nouns in sentences to avoid repetition and make sentences less cumbersome.

words.tr: phrase. 学习系统；学习方法体系
words.ex: He studies the study system in his school.
words.ex_cn: 他研究自己学校的教学体系。
words.en: An organized method or framework for learning or conducting research.

words.tr: n. 分心；干扰；
words.ex: Phone notifications are common distractions while studying.
words.ex_cn: 手机通知是学习时常见的分心因素。
words.en: Something that prevents someone from concentrating on something else.

words.tr: phrase. 心态；心情；精神状态
words.ex: He is in a good frame of mind today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天心情很好。
words.en: A particular mood that influences your attitudes or behaviour.

words.tr: n. 笔记本
words.ex: He writes his homework in a notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业写在笔记本里。
words.en: A notebook is a small book for writing notes in, or a small computer that is easy to carry.

words.tr: phrase. 标题；标题们（heading 的复数形式）
words.ex: The headings tell us what each section is about.
words.ex_cn: 这些标题告诉我们每一部分的内容。
words.en: The headings refer to the titles or subtitles that are used to organize and label sections of a document or text.

words.tr: phrase. 关键词；关键字；用于索引或检索的重要词语
words.ex: These key words help you understand the story.
words.ex_cn: 这些关键词帮助你理解故事。
words.en: Significant or representative terms that capture the essence of a topic.

words.tr: phrase. 出声地；大声地
words.ex: He read the book out loud.
words.ex_cn: 他大声读了这本书。
words.en: If you say something out loud, you say it so that other people can hear you.

words.tr: adv. 大声地；
words.ex: He shouted loudly to get attention.
words.ex_cn: 他大声喊叫以引起注意。
words.en: In a way that produces or is capable of producing much noise; not quietly.

words.tr: v. 设法做到；管理；
words.ex: I managed to finish my homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我设法在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: To manage means to be in charge of or control something, especially a business or a group of people.

words.tr: phrase. 到期日；应付日期（指账单、作业、还款等应完成或支付的截止日期）
words.ex: The due dates are next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 截止日期是下周一。
words.en: The final date by which something must be completed or submitted.

words.tr:
n. 圆；圈；
v. 圈出；环绕；
words.ex: The child drew a circle with a pen.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用笔画了一个圆。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

words.tr: phrase. 工作与阶级；劳动与社会阶层
words.ex: He often talks about work and class in his essays.
words.ex_cn: 他经常在文章中谈论工作与阶级。
words.en: A phrase describing the two main social categories in the novel *The Great Gatsby*, representing the established, old-money elite (class) and the self-made, industrious individuals (work).

words.tr: phrase. 待办事项清单；任务列表
words.ex: I write my tasks on to-do lists every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上把任务写在待办事项列表上。
words.en: A list of tasks that need to be completed, often organized by priority or deadline.

words.tr: phrase. 积极的态度；乐观心态
words.ex: He has a positive attitude every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都保持积极的态度。
words.en: A positive attitude refers to a mindset that focuses on the good and expects positive outcomes.

words.tr: 短语动词. 提出一个问题；询问
words.ex: He asks a question in class every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在课堂上问一个问题。
words.en: To pose a query or seek information from someone.

words.tr: 短语动词. 提出问题；询问
words.ex: He always asks questions in class.
words.ex_cn: 他总是在课堂上提出问题。
words.en: To pose a query or seek information from someone.

words.tr:
adj. 成熟的；
v. 成熟；
words.ex: He is a mature student who works full-time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成熟的学生，全职工作。
words.en: When something or someone matures, they become fully grown or developed. In finance, a mature investment is one that has reached the end of its term and is ready to be paid out.

words.tr: n. 模式；图案；“pattern”的复数；
words.ex: The children noticed patterns in the tiles on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们注意到了地板瓷砖上的模式。
words.en: Designs or motifs that are repeated in a predictable sequence.

words.tr: v. 协商；谈判；通过；
words.ex: They will negotiate the price with the seller.
words.ex_cn: 他们会与卖家协商价格。
words.en: If people negotiate with each other or negotiate an agreement, they talk about a problem or a situation such as a business arrangement in order to solve the problem or complete the arrangement.

words.tr: n. 方向；指导；指示；
words.ex: He asked for the direction to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他问了去车站的方向。
words.en: A direction is the way that you have to travel to get from one place to another, or the way that something is moving or pointing.

words.tr: n. 能力；
words.ex: His competence in math helped him solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面的能力帮助他解决了这个问题。
words.en: Competence is the ability to do something well or efficiently.

words.tr: n.心理语言学
words.ex: He is studying psycholinguistics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里学习心理语言学。
words.en: Psycholinguistics is the study of the psychological and neurobiological factors that enable humans to acquire, use, and understand language.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；潜在的； v. “underlie”的现在分词；
words.ex: The underlying cause of the problem is poverty.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的根本原因是贫困。
words.en: An underlying thing is the thing that is the most important or basic, although it is not easily noticed or stated directly.

words.tr: n. 获得；得到的东西；收购；
words.ex: The acquisition of new skills takes time.
words.ex_cn: 获得新技能需要时间。
words.en: An acquisition is something that someone buys, often to add to a collection of things.

words.tr: n. 关联性；关系；亲缘
words.ex: The relatedness of the two families is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这两个家庭之间的关联很明显。
words.en: The state or condition of being connected or associated with something else.

words.tr: phrase. 应用语言学（将语言学理论应用于实际问题，如语言教学、翻译、语言政策等）
words.ex: He is studying applied linguistics to teach English better.
words.ex_cn: 他学习应用语言学以更好地教授英语。
words.en: Applied linguistics is an interdisciplinary field which identifies, investigates, and offers solutions to language-related real-life problems. Some of the academic fields related to applied linguistics are education, psychology, communication research, anthropology, and sociology.

words.tr: n.错误
words.ex: He made many errors in his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学作业中犯了很多错误。
words.en: Mistakes or inaccuracies, especially those that are the result of a failure to follow a set of rules or standards.

words.tr: n. 动机；动力；
words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.tr: n. 文化；培养；
words.ex: I love learning about different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢了解不同的文化。
words.en: The ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society.

words.tr: adj. 哲学的；
words.ex: He gave a philosophical answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个哲学性的回答。
words.en: Relating to or based on philosophy; calm and thoughtful in the face of problems.

words.tr: n. 倾向，趋势；倾向，趋势( tendency的名词复数 )；
words.ex: Children have tendencies to copy their parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子有模仿父母的倾向。
words.en: A tendency is a likelihood or natural inclination to behave in a particular way or to have a particular characteristic.

words.tr: phrase. 在大脑中；在脑部
words.ex: The memory is stored in the brain.
words.ex_cn: 记忆储存在大脑中。
words.en: Refers to the physical organ responsible for thought, memory, and emotion; often used metaphorically to mean 'in one's mind' or 'mentally'.

words.tr: phrase. 语言的使用；语言运用方式
words.ex: He showed good use of language in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中展现了良好的语言运用。
words.en: The manner in which language is used, especially in a particular context or for a particular purpose.

words.tr: v. 创造；制造硬币( coin的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He coined a new word for the invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为这项发明创造了一个新词。
words.en: To coin a word or phrase means to invent it.

words.tr: v. 创造；创作；“create”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He created a beautiful painting.
words.ex_cn: 他创造了一幅美丽的画。
words.en: To bring something into existence.

words.tr: n. 背景；经历；
words.ex: He changed his job because of his background.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的背景换了工作。
words.en: The background is the situation that exists at a particular time, or the situation in which something happens, which helps to explain it.

words.tr: phrase. 人们使用的词语；日常用语或特定群体惯用的词汇表达
words.ex: These are words people use every day.
words.ex_cn: 这些是人们每天使用的词语。
words.en: The vocabulary or terminology commonly employed by a particular group, community, or in a specific situation.

words.tr: phrase. 特定的；明确的 n. 含义；意思
words.ex: The word 'bank' has a specific meaning in this sentence.
words.ex_cn: 在这个句子中，'bank' 有特定的含义。
words.en: The particular sense or interpretation that a word, phrase, or concept has in a given situation.

words.tr: phrase. 社交线索；社会暗示（指人们在社交互动中通过语言、表情、肢体动作等传递的非正式信号）
words.ex: He didn't understand the social cues at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上没有理解社交暗示。
words.en: Social cues are verbal or non-verbal hints that guide social interactions. They can include facial expressions, body language, tone of voice, and other signals that help people understand the context of a conversation or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 补充物；补足物； compliment 的误用（正确拼写为 complement，意为使完整的东西）
words.ex: The hat is a complement to her dress.
words.ex_cn: 这顶帽子是她裙子的搭配。
words.en: Something that completes or brings to perfection; in grammar, a word or phrase that completes the meaning of a verb (e.g., 'She read *a book*').

words.tr: 短语动词. 增加体重；发胖
words.ex: He eats too much and gains weight.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多，体重增加了。
words.en: To increase in body weight.

words.tr: phrase. 回应
words.ex: He did not respond to the message yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有回复那条信息。
words.en: To react or answer to something, such as a question, request, or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 向……提供反馈；对……作出回应
words.ex: The teacher gives feedback to the students after the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试后给学生反馈。
words.en: To provide constructive or evaluative comments to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 信息共享；资讯分享
words.ex: The team practices sharing of information to work better together.
words.ex_cn: 团队进行信息共享以更好地合作。
words.en: The act of making information available to others, either within an organization or between different organizations or individuals.

words.tr: phrase. 一种浪费；无谓的消耗
words.ex: It is a waste to throw away food.
words.ex_cn: 把食物扔掉是浪费。
words.en: Something that is useless or not worth the time, effort, or resources spent on it.

words.tr: phrase. 一个垄断行为；对市场或行业的独占控制
words.ex: The company tried a monopolization of the market.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司试图垄断市场。
words.en: The act of taking exclusive control or possession of something, especially a market or resource.

words.tr: n.意图
words.ex: His intentions are good.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是好的。
words.en: An intention is an idea or plan of what you are going to do.

words.tr: phrase. 患有自闭症的儿童
words.ex: Children with autism often enjoy quiet games.
words.ex_cn: 自闭症儿童通常喜欢安静的游戏。
words.en: Young people diagnosed with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), a developmental condition affecting social interaction and communication.

words.tr: phrase. 更合理的；更公道的；更通情达理的
words.ex: This plan is more reasonable than the last one.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划比上一个更合理。
words.en: More logical, sensible, or based on sound judgment; less extreme or irrational.

words.tr: phrase. 上下文；语境；背景
words.ex: The context of the story helps us understand the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的背景帮助我们理解其含义。
words.en: The circumstances, setting, or background information that helps explain the meaning of a situation, word, or event.

words.tr: phrase. 关键期；临界期（指在发展过程中对特定刺激或经验特别敏感的时期）
words.ex: Children learn language best during the critical period.
words.ex_cn: 儿童在关键期学习语言效果最好。
words.en: A critical period is a specific time during an organism's development when it is particularly sensitive to certain environmental stimuli, and certain abilities or characteristics are most easily acquired.

words.tr: phrase. 随机声音；杂乱声响
words.ex: The baby makes random sounds while sleeping.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿睡觉时发出随机的声音。
words.en: Unstructured, non-representational, or meaningless sounds produced without deliberate purpose or pattern.

words.tr: phrase. 青少年时期；十几岁的时光
words.ex: He remembers his teenage time as the happiest years of his life.
words.ex_cn: 他记得自己的青少年时期是他一生中最幸福的时光。
words.en: The period of adolescence, typically from ages 13 to 19, characterized by significant physical, emotional, and social development.

words.tr: adj. 不完全的；不完整的；
words.ex: The puzzle is incomplete without the last piece.
words.ex_cn: 没有最后一块，这个拼图是不完全的。
words.en: If something is incomplete, it is not yet finished, or it does not have all the parts that it should have.

words.tr: n. 阶段；“stage”的复数；
words.ex: The project has three main stages.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目有三个主要阶段。
words.en: A stage is a particular point or period in the development or progress of something. It can also refer to a raised platform on which actors, entertainers, or speakers perform.

words.tr: phrase. 十二个月；一年
words.ex: He worked for twelve months without a break.
words.ex_cn: 他连续工作了十二个月，没有休息。
words.en: A period of twelve calendar months, equivalent to one year.

words.tr: v. 增加；提高；
words.ex: The temperature increases in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天温度升高。
words.en: To become or make greater in size, amount, intensity, or degree.

words.tr: phrase. 两三个；少数几个
words.ex: I need two or three apples for the pie.
words.ex_cn: 我做派需要两三个苹果。
words.en: A small, indefinite number, typically meaning a few (often implying a limited quantity or a short duration).

words.tr: phrase. 指称问题；关于词语或符号如何指向世界中的对象或概念的哲学难题
words.ex: The problem of reference is hard for children to understand.
words.ex_cn: 参考问题对孩子来说很难理解。
words.en: The philosophical issue of how words or symbols connect to real-world entities or concepts.

words.tr:
n. 种类；
adj. 善良的；和蔼的；
words.ex: There are many kinds of fruits in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you describe someone as kind, you mean that they are gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.tr: n. 类别
words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.tr: phrase. 种类或类别
words.ex: A dog is a kind of animal.
words.ex_cn: 狗是一种动物。
words.en: A particular type, class, or group that something belongs to.

words.tr: 短语：带有标签的；附有标签的
words.ex: The bottle has a drink with a label.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子上有一瓶带有标签的饮料。
words.en: Marked or identified by a tag or name, often for classification or description.

words.tr: phrase. 特定的；具体的 + n. 上下文；语境
words.ex: The word means different things in a specific context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在特定的语境中意思不同。
words.en: The particular circumstances or setting in which something exists or occurs.

words.tr: n. 语法
words.ex: He is learning English grammar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在学习英语语法。
words.en: Grammar is the system and structure of a language. The rules of grammar help us decide the order we put words in and which form of a word to use.

words.tr: phrase. 手语；一种通过手势、面部表情和身体动作进行交流的语言系统，常用于听障人士之间
words.ex: He uses sign language to talk with his deaf sister.
words.ex_cn: 他用手语和他的聋哑妹妹交流。
words.en: A system of communication that uses gestures, facial expressions, and body movements to convey meaning, especially among people who are deaf or hard of hearing.

words.tr: phrase. 语法结构；句子或短语中词语的组织方式，符合语法规则的构造形式
words.ex: He learned the grammatical structure of simple sentences.
words.ex_cn: 他学习了简单句子的语法结构。
words.en: The grammatical structure refers to the way in which words are arranged to form sentences, clauses, and phrases in a language, according to the rules of grammar.

words.tr: phrase. 研究结果；学习成果
words.ex: The study results show that students improved their math skills.
words.ex_cn: 研究结果表明学生的数学能力提高了。
words.en: The findings or conclusions from a systematic investigation or academic research.

words.tr: n. (调查或研究的）结果；发现；
words.ex: The study's findings show that sleep helps memory.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究的结果表明，睡眠有助于记忆。
words.en: The results of an investigation or research; something that is discovered.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏知识的观众；不了解情况的听众
words.ex: The speaker struggled to explain the topic to an unknowledgeable audience.
words.ex_cn: 演讲者很难向一群缺乏知识的观众解释这个话题。
words.en: A group of listeners or readers lacking specialized knowledge on a subject.

words.tr: adj. 遵守纪律的； v. “discipline”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a disciplined student who always arrives on time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个遵守纪律的学生，总是准时到达。
words.en: Someone who is disciplined behaves in a controlled way, obeying rules or standards.

words.tr: 你所做的事情（短语）
words.ex: What you did was wrong.
words.ex_cn: 你所做的事是错的。
words.en: The specific actions or conduct you performed in a past situation.

words.tr: n. 方法；办法；
words.ex: He found a new method to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: A method is a particular way of doing something.

words.tr: n. 讨论；商讨；
words.ex: We had a discussion about homework.
words.ex_cn: 我们进行了一次关于作业的讨论。
words.en: A discussion is a conversation or debate about a specific topic.

words.tr: phrase. 一个常见的错误
words.ex: He made a common mistake in his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学作业中犯了一个常见的错误。
words.en: An error or misconception that occurs frequently.

words.tr: phrase. 实际上；事实上
words.ex: He looks happy, but in reality, he is sad.
words.ex_cn: 他看起来很开心，但事实上，他很难过。
words.en: used to emphasize what is actually the case, as opposed to what people might think

words.tr: phrase. 背景资料；背景知识
words.ex: He gave us some background information about the project.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我们一些关于这个项目的背景信息。
words.en: Background information refers to the essential details or context that is necessary to understand a particular situation, event, or subject matter fully.

words.tr: phrase. + noun. 清晰的论点；明确的论证
words.ex: He gave clear arguments in the debate.
words.ex_cn: 他在辩论中提出了清晰的论点。
words.en: Logical and well-reasoned points presented to support a position or claim.

words.tr: n. 定义；
words.ex: The dictionary gives a clear definition of the word.
words.ex_cn: 词典给出了这个词的清晰定义。
words.en: A statement of the exact meaning of a word, phrase, or concept.

words.tr: phrase. 收集与分析
words.ex: He does collection and analysis of data every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天做数据的收集和分析。
words.en: The process of gathering data and examining it to draw conclusions.

words.tr:
n. 格式；
v. 格式化；
words.ex: The file is in PDF format.
words.ex_cn: 这个文件是PDF格式。
words.en: The way in which something is arranged or set out.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.tr: n. 强调；重点；
words.ex: The teacher put emphasis on reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调每天都要阅读。
words.en: Special importance, value, or prominence given to something.

words.tr: n. 正当的理由；
words.ex: He gave a justification for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他为迟到提供了一个正当的理由。
words.en: A justification for something is an acceptable reason or explanation for it.

words.tr: n. 黑板
words.ex: The teacher writes on the chalkboard.
words.ex_cn: 老师在黑板上写字。
words.en: A chalkboard is a dark-colored board that you can write on with chalk and then clean off.

words.tr: n. 黑板
words.ex: The teacher writes on the blackboard.
words.ex_cn: 老师在黑板上写字。
words.en: A blackboard is a dark-colored board that you can write on with chalk, used especially in classrooms.

words.tr: phrase. 理论概念
words.ex: He learns theoretical concepts in physics class.
words.ex_cn: 他在物理课上学习理论概念。
words.en: Theoretical concepts refer to ideas or principles that are based on theory rather than practical experience or observation.

words.tr: phrase. 幼树；年轻的树木
words.ex: The young trees are growing near the house.
words.ex_cn: 小树正在房子附近生长。
words.en: Trees that are in the early stages of growth and development.

words.tr: n.解释
words.ex: The teacher gave simple explanations for the math problems.
words.ex_cn: 老师对数学题给出了简单的解释。
words.en: Statements that make something clear or provide reasons for something.

words.tr: phrase. 与学生交流；与学生沟通
words.ex: The teacher communicates with students every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师每天与学生交流。
words.en: To exchange information or ideas with learners in an educational setting.

words.tr: phrase. 陈述它；说明它
words.ex: He will state it clearly in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他将在会议上清楚地说明它。
words.en: To express or formulate a point clearly and directly.

words.tr: v. 总结；
words.ex: Can you summarize the story in one sentence?
words.ex_cn: 你能用一句话总结这个故事吗？
words.en: If you summarize something, you give a brief description of its main points.

words.tr: phrase. 变化或过渡；指事物从一种状态转变为另一种状态的过程
words.ex: The change from winter to spring is a natural transition.
words.ex_cn: 从冬天到春天的变化是一种自然的过渡。
words.en: A process of becoming different or moving from one state to another.

words.tr:
v. 停止；阻止；
n. 停止；阻止；车站；停留；
words.ex: He stopped walking when he saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到狗时，他停止了走路。
words.en: If you stop something from happening, you prevent it from happening or prevent it from continuing.

words.tr: phrase. 这场讲座；这个演讲
words.ex: The lecture starts at nine o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 讲座九点开始。
words.en: A lecture is a talk or speech given to a group of people, especially students, to teach them about a particular subject.

words.tr: n. 序言；前言；
words.ex: He read the preface before starting the book.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始读这本书之前读了序言。
words.en: A preface is an introduction at the beginning of a book, which explains what the book is about or why it was written.

words.tr: phrase. 常用短语；常见表达方式
words.ex: He uses common phrases in his daily conversations.
words.ex_cn: 他在日常对话中使用常用短语。
words.en: Frequently used expressions in a language or context.

words.tr: phrase. 帮助；援助（特指家政或佣人服务，常见于美式英语口语或影视作品中）
words.ex: He got the help he needed from his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他从老师那里得到了所需的帮助。
words.en: Assistance or support provided to someone.

words.tr: adj. 支持的；支援的；给予帮助的；
words.ex: My parents are supportive when I study hard.
words.ex_cn: 当我努力学习时，我的父母总是支持我。
words.en: If you are supportive, you are kind and helpful to someone at a difficult or unhappy time in their life.

words.tr: adj. 宽容的；容忍的；
words.ex: My teacher is tolerant of different opinions.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师对不同的观点很宽容。
words.en: If you describe someone as tolerant, you approve of the fact that they allow other people to say and do as they like, even if they do not agree with or like it.

words.tr: adj. 连续的；连贯的；
words.ex: He missed three consecutive days of school.
words.ex_cn: 他连续三天没上学。
words.en: Consecutive events, numbers, etc. follow one after another without an interruption.

words.tr: phrase. 背景资料；背景知识
words.ex: He gave us some background information about the project.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我们一些关于这个项目的背景信息。
words.en: Background information refers to the essential details or context that is necessary to understand a particular situation, event, or subject matter fully.

words.tr: phrase. 目的与目标；意图与追求
words.ex: His purpose and goal is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的与目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: The reason for doing something and the intended outcome.

words.tr: phrase. 精读
words.ex: He does intensive reading every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上进行精读。
words.en: Intensive reading refers to the thorough and detailed reading of texts, often with the aim of understanding and analyzing their content deeply.

words.tr: n. 布局；布置；
words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.tr: phrase. 主动阅读；积极阅读（指在阅读过程中积极思考、提问、做笔记以增强理解和记忆的阅读方式）
words.ex: He uses active reading to understand the book better.
words.ex_cn: 他使用主动阅读来更好地理解这本书。
words.en: Active reading is a process of reading that involves actively engaging with the text by asking questions, making notes, and summarizing key points to enhance understanding and retention.

words.tr: n. 提问； v. 怀疑；“question”的现在分词； adj. 表示怀疑的；
words.ex: His questioning helped the teacher understand the students' confusion.
words.ex_cn: 他的提问帮助老师理解了学生的困惑。
words.en: The act of asking questions in order to gather information or to express doubt.

words.tr: phrase. 先前的知识；已有知识
words.ex: He used the prior knowledge to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他利用了先前的知识来解决这个问题。
words.en: Knowledge that someone already has before learning or experiencing something new.

words.tr: n. 上下文；语境；环境；
words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.tr: phrase. 组成部分；构成部件；零件
words.ex: The toy has many component parts that fit together.
words.ex_cn: 这个玩具有很多可以拼合的零部件。
words.en: The component parts of something are the parts that make it up.

words.tr: n. （某物）相当大的数量或部分；厚厚的一块；厚厚的一块( chunk的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He ate chunks of bread with cheese.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了大块的面包配奶酪。
words.en: A chunk of something is a large amount or large part of it.

words.tr: v. 释义，意译( paraphrase的现在分词 )
words.ex: He is paraphrasing the paragraph to make it simpler.
words.ex_cn: 他正在改写这段话，使其更简单。
words.en: Paraphrasing involves rewording or rephrasing text or speech in order to achieve greater clarity, often to simplify or clarify the original content without changing its meaning.

words.tr: phrase. 另一种想法；另一个想法
words.ex: He offered another mind to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了另一种想法来解决这个问题。
words.en: An alternative perspective or way of thinking.

words.tr: phrase. 各种各样的活动
words.ex: Children enjoy various activities after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢放学后参加各种各样的活动。
words.en: A range of different events, tasks, or pursuits offered for participation, often for educational or social purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 表格和图表
words.ex: He draws forms and charts for his report.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的报告绘制表格和图表。
words.en: Structured documents used for recording information.

words.tr: phrase. 极端的主观性；完全基于个人感受或观点，缺乏客观依据的状态
words.ex: His opinion is based on extreme subjectivity.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点基于极度的主观性。
words.en: A tendency to interpret situations or phenomena in a way that is heavily influenced by personal feelings, tastes, or opinions.

words.tr:
adj. 智力的；
n. 知识分子；
words.ex: He is an intellectual person who loves solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱解决数学问题的智力型人。
words.en: An intellectual is someone who spends a lot of time studying and thinking about complicated ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 提前；预先
words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.tr: n. 基址；（秘密）计划( plot的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The ancient temple was built on plots of sacred land.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙建在神圣的基址上。
words.en: Plans or schemes, often secret or illegal, or the main storyline of a book or film.

words.tr: phrase. 课堂参与度成绩；平时参与评分
words.ex: His participation grade is high because he speaks in class.
words.ex_cn: 他的参与分数很高，因为他经常在课堂上发言。
words.en: A mark given for taking part in an activity.

words.tr: phrase. 害羞的；内向的 + n. 个体；个人 → 害羞的人；内向的个体
words.ex: Shy individuals often avoid speaking in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 害羞的人常常避免在全班面前说话。
words.en: People who are reserved or hesitant in social situations.

words.tr: phrase. 微妙的差异；不易察觉的区别
words.ex: There are subtle differences between the two versions.
words.ex_cn: 这两个版本之间有微妙的差异。
words.en: Subtle differences refer to small, almost unnoticeable distinctions between things that are very similar.

words.tr: phrase. 阅读并消化；仔细阅读并理解
words.ex: Students must read and digest the textbook before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 学生必须在考试前阅读并消化教科书。
words.en: To read and fully understand information.

words.tr: v. 掠过；略读；
words.ex: The stone skimmed over the water.
words.ex_cn: 石头掠过水面。
words.en: To remove a substance from the surface of a liquid, or to read or consider something quickly in order to understand the main points, without studying it in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 更深层次的意图；更深层的动机或目的
words.ex: He tried to understand her deeper intentions behind the kind words.
words.ex_cn: 他试图理解她那些善意话语背后的更深层次的意图。
words.en: Deeper intentions refer to the underlying or more profound motives behind someone's actions or words, which are not immediately apparent.

words.tr: phrase. 集中的，注重细节的；对重点有清晰关注且详尽周密的
words.ex: He is focused and detailed when he does his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做数学作业时专注且细致。
words.en: Characterized by concentration and thoroughness.

words.tr: phrase. 文本证据；指从书面材料中提取的、用于支持论点或解释的引文或内容
words.ex: He used textual evidence to support his answer.
words.ex_cn: 他使用了文本证据来支持他的答案。
words.en: Textual evidence refers to written or printed material that is used as proof or support in an argument or investigation.

words.tr: n. 矛盾( contradiction的名词复数 ); 否认，反驳
words.ex: He sees contradictions in the two stories.
words.ex_cn: 他发现这两个故事中有矛盾。
words.en: A contradiction is a situation or statement that involves two or more facts or qualities that seem to oppose each other.

words.tr: adj. 有辨别力的；能洞悉的；眼光敏锐的； v. “discern”的现在分词；
words.ex: She is a discerning shopper who always finds the best quality.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有辨别力的购物者，总是能找到最好的质量。
words.en: If you describe someone as discerning, you mean that they are able to judge which things of a particular kind are good and which are bad.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.tr: adj. 有关的；有牵连的；繁杂的； v. 包括；牵涉；“involve”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is involved in the school project.
words.ex_cn: 他与这个学校项目有关。
words.en: If a situation or activity is involved, it has a lot of different parts or aspects, often making it complicated or difficult to understand.

words.tr: phrase. 最终的解决办法；最终决议
words.ex: They reached a final resolution after months of talks.
words.ex_cn: 经过数月的谈判，他们达成了最终解决方案。
words.en: A definitive conclusion or decision.

words.tr: n. 试验；审判；试用；
words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.tr:
n. 吸引力；上诉；
v. 吸引；诉请；呼吁；
words.ex: The appeal of the beach drew many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 海滩的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: If you appeal to someone to do something, you make a serious and urgent request to them. If you appeal against a decision or sentence, you formally ask a court or other authority to change it. If something appeals to you, you like it or it interests you.

words.tr: phrase. 对待生命本身；把生命本身视为某种方式来处理或看待
words.ex: He tries to treat life itself with kindness and care.
words.ex_cn: 他努力以善意和关怀对待生活本身。
words.en: To regard or handle life in a particular manner.

words.tr: phrase. 创建角色；创造人物
words.ex: He likes to create characters for his stories.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢为他的故事创造角色。
words.en: To invent or develop fictional figures for a story, play, or other creative work.

words.tr: n. 个性；人格；
words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；反省；思考；仔细考虑；
words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If a surface reflects light, heat, sound, or an image, it sends the light, etc. back and does not absorb it. If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.tr: phrase. 感到好奇的或困惑的；既被吸引又迷惑的
words.ex: He looked at the strange box, intrigued or puzzled.
words.ex_cn: 他看着那个奇怪的盒子，感到好奇或困惑。
words.en: Feeling curious or confused about something.

words.tr: n. 长处；优点；“strength”的复数；
words.ex: His strengths are patience and honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他的长处是耐心和诚实。
words.en: Strengths refer to the qualities or abilities that someone or something has that are an advantage to them.

words.tr: phrase. 人类
words.ex: Human beings need water to live.
words.ex_cn: 人类需要水来生存。
words.en: Human beings are members of the species Homo sapiens, characterized by their superior intelligence, articulate speech, and upright stance.

words.tr: n. 事情；物质；问题；麻烦；“matter”的复数
words.ex: These matters are important to him.
words.ex_cn: 这些事情对他很重要。
words.en: Matters refer to subjects or situations that are under consideration or discussion.

words.tr: n. 知识；了解；学问；学识；
words.ex: He gained knowledge from reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他通过读书获得了知识。
words.en: Knowledge is information and understanding about a subject which a person has, or which all people have.

words.tr: adj. 失去的；失踪的； v. 错失；“miss”的现在分词；
words.ex: The missing book was found under the bed.
words.ex_cn: 那本丢失的书在床下找到了。
words.en: If someone or something is missing, they are not in their usual place, and you cannot find them.

words.tr: phrase. 无定论且琐碎的；无法得出明确结论且微不足道的
words.ex: The results were inconclusive and trivial.
words.ex_cn: 结果既无结论又微不足道。
words.en: Not leading to a firm conclusion or result; of little value or importance.

words.tr: v. 完成；使完善( complete的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is completing his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他正在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To finish making or doing something.

words.tr: v. 完成；结束；“finish”的现在分词； n. 结尾；结束；完成； adj. 最后的；完工的；
words.ex: He is finishing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正在完成他的作业。
words.en: The act of completing something or the final touches added to something.

words.tr:
n. 钩；挂钩；
v. 钩住；
words.ex: The key hung on a metal hook.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙挂在金属钩上。
words.en: A hook is a bent piece of metal or plastic that is used for catching or holding things, or for hanging things on.

words.tr: phrase. 以往的研究；先前的研究
words.ex: Previous researches show that sleep helps memory.
words.ex_cn: 以往的研究表明，睡眠有助于记忆。
words.en: Studies or investigations conducted before the current one, often serving as a foundation.

words.tr: n. 目标；进球得分；球门；
words.ex: His goal is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A goal is an aim or purpose that a person or a group of people is trying to achieve.

words.tr: n. 承认；感谢；致谢
words.ex: He sent an acknowledgement email after receiving the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他收到礼物后发了一封确认邮件。
words.en: An acknowledgement is a statement or action which recognizes that something exists or is true.

words.tr: n. 范围；
words.ex: The scope of this project includes three cities.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的范围包括三个城市。
words.en: The range of one's perceptions, thoughts, or actions.

words.tr: n. 贡献；捐助物；
words.ex: His contribution helped the team win.
words.ex_cn: 他的贡献帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: A contribution is a gift or payment to a common fund or collection, or the part played by a person or thing in bringing about a result or helping something to advance.

words.tr: 短语动词. 评估可信度；判断某事是否可信
words.ex: The teacher asks students to assess the believability of the story.
words.ex_cn: 老师让学生评估这个故事的可信度。
words.en: To evaluate the credibility or likelihood of something being true.

words.tr: n.过程
words.ex: The doctor follows simple procedures to help patients.
words.ex_cn: 医生遵循简单的程序来帮助病人。
words.en: A procedure is a way of doing something, especially the usual or correct way.

words.tr: n. 假定；设想；
words.ex: The experiment is based on simple assumptions.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验基于简单的假定。
words.en: An assumption is something that you assume to be the case, even without proof.

words.tr: n.观察
words.ex: He made careful observations about the birds.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细观察了这些鸟。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully, in order to gain information.

words.tr: v. 总结；
words.ex: Can you summarize the story in one sentence?
words.ex_cn: 你能用一句话总结这个故事吗？
words.en: If you summarize something, you give a brief description of its main points.

words.tr: phrase. 简短的文章；短篇论述
words.ex: He wrote a brief essay about his summer vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假的短文。
words.en: A brief essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.tr: adj. 类似的；相像的；
words.ex: The two dogs are similar in color.
words.ex_cn: 这两只狗的颜色很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.tr: 短语：使用副标题；指在文章或文档中采用次级标题以组织内容
words.ex: He is using subheadings to organize his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他正在使用小标题来组织他的文章。
words.en: Dividing a text into sections with titles to improve structure and readability.

words.tr: n. 结构；构造；
words.ex: The bridge has strong structures to support weight.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有坚固的结构来承受重量。
words.en: Structures refer to the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex. They can also denote buildings or other constructions standing as a whole.

words.tr: v. 过分强调；“overemphasize”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He overemphasized the importance of grades.
words.ex_cn: 他过分强调了成绩的重要性。
words.en: If you say that something cannot be overemphasized, you are emphasizing that it is very important.

words.tr: phrase. 社会关系；社交关系
words.ex: He improves his social relations by talking to neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他通过与邻居交谈来改善人际关系。
words.en: Social relations refer to the various interactions and relationships between individuals and groups within a society.

words.tr:
n. 形状；身材；定形；
v. 塑造；
words.ex: The shape of the table is round.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子的形状是圆形的。
words.en: The shape of an object is its external form or outline, which can be seen and felt.

words.tr: phrase. 提供有用信息的；增进知识的；解释性的；说明性的
words.ex: The book is informative and explanatory about how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对植物如何生长进行了详尽且易懂的说明。
words.en: Providing useful facts and clear explanations to educate the reader.

words.tr: phrase. 显著的差异；引人注目的不同之处
words.ex: There are striking differences between the two cities.
words.ex_cn: 这两座城市之间有显著的差异。
words.en: Noticeable and significant distinctions between things being compared.

words.tr: n. 态度；姿势（复数形式）；
words.ex: His attitudes toward homework are very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, especially as shown by your behavior.

words.tr: adj. 有说服力的；
words.ex: His speech was persuasive and made everyone agree.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲很有说服力，让所有人都同意了。
words.en: A persuasive argument or reason is one that makes you believe that something is true or right.

words.tr: phrase. 理由与论据；原因及论点
words.ex: He gave reasons and arguments for his decision.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了他决定的理由和论据。
words.en: Reasons and arguments refer to the explanations and points made to support or oppose a particular idea or action.

words.tr: adj. 中性的；中立的；
words.ex: He stayed neutral in the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持中立。
words.en: If you say that someone is neutral, you mean that they do not support or help either side in a disagreement, competition, or war.

words.tr: phrase. 怀疑和担忧
words.ex: He has doubts and concerns about the new plan.
words.ex_cn: 他对新计划有疑虑和担忧。
words.en: Feelings of uncertainty and worry about a particular issue or situation.

words.tr: n. 成见，偏见，歧视；成见，偏见，歧视( prejudice的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He overcame his prejudices against different cultures.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了对不同文化的偏见。
words.en: If you prejudice someone or something, you influence them so that they are unfair in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 最佳方法；最优途径
words.ex: The best approach is to practice every day.
words.ex_cn: 最好的方法是每天练习。
words.en: The most effective or suitable method for achieving a desired result.

words.tr: adj. 有关历史的
words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.tr: n. 正式手续；
words.ex: The visa application requires a lot of formality.
words.ex_cn: 签证申请需要很多正式手续。
words.en: A formality is something that is done as part of a formal process or procedure, often without much thought or feeling because it is expected.

words.tr: n.文化
words.ex: Different cultures have different traditions.
words.ex_cn: 不同的文化有不同的传统。
words.en: The customs, arts, social institutions, and achievements of a particular nation, people, or other social group.

words.tr: 动词短语. 产生想法；构思；提出创意
words.ex: He is generating ideas for a new project.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为一个新项目产生想法。
words.en: Producing new thoughts, concepts, or creative concepts.

words.tr: n. 群组；团体；“group”的复数；
words.ex: The students are divided into small groups.
words.ex_cn: 学生们被分成几个小组。
words.en: A group of people or things is a number of people or things which are together in one place at one time.

words.tr: adj. 相关的；
words.ex: This information is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这些信息与我们的项目相关。
words.en: Something that is relevant to a situation or person is important or significant in that situation or to that person.

words.tr:
adj. 特指的；特殊的；挑剔的；
n. 细节；详情；
words.ex: He wants a particular book, not any other.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一本特指的书，不是别的。
words.en: You use particular to emphasize that you are talking about one thing or one kind of thing rather than other similar ones.

words.tr: phrase. 一种图形化的思维工具，用于组织信息和表达想法之间的关联，中文称为“思维导图”
words.ex: He drew a mind map to remember the words.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个思维导图来记住这些单词。
words.en: A mind map is a diagram used to visually organize information, often created around a single concept, drawn as an image in the center of a blank page, to which associated representations of ideas such as images, words and parts of words are added.

words.tr: n. 拼写；拼法； v. “spell”的现在分词；
words.ex: His spelling is very poor.
words.ex_cn: 他的拼写很差。
words.en: The forming of words from letters according to accepted usage; orthography.

words.tr: phrase. 典型的文本；具有代表性的文字材料
words.ex: These are typical texts for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这些是初学者的典型文本。
words.en: Typical texts refer to standard or representative examples of written material that are commonly used or referenced in a particular context.

words.tr: n. 特征；特点；面貌特征；“feature”的复数； v. 以…为特色；
words.ex: The features of this phone are very useful.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的特征非常有用。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.tr: phrase. 主题句（复数）；段落中表达中心思想的句子
words.ex: Topic sentences help readers understand the main idea of a paragraph.
words.ex_cn: 主题句帮助读者理解段落的主要意思。
words.en: A topic sentence is a sentence that expresses the main idea of a paragraph, around which all other sentences in the paragraph revolve.

words.tr: phrase. 组织思想；整理思路
words.ex: He is organizing ideas for his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为他的文章整理思路。
words.en: Arranging thoughts or concepts in a logical and coherent order.

words.tr:
n. 组；群；集团；
v. （使）形成组；
words.ex: The students are in a group of five.
words.ex_cn: 这些学生组成一个五人小组。
words.en: A group is a number of people or things that are located, gathered, or classed together.

words.tr: phrase. 一个观众；听众
words.ex: He spoke to an audience of fifty people.
words.ex_cn: 他向五十人的观众演讲。
words.en: The group of people gathered in a place to watch or listen to a play, film, someone speaking, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 其他学习者的
words.ex: Other learners often share tips to help each other.
words.ex_cn: 其他学习者经常分享技巧来互相帮助。
words.en: People who are studying the same subject or subject matter as you.

words.tr: phrase. 语法和拼写
words.ex: He checked his grammar and spelling before submitting the essay.
words.ex_cn: 他在提交作文前检查了语法和拼写。
words.en: The rules and conventions governing the structure and use of a language, including its written form.

words.tr: adj. 独立的；自主的；
words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.tr: phrase. 口头媒介；通过口头交流的信息传播方式
words.ex: He uses oral medium to explain the story.
words.ex_cn: 他用口头方式讲述这个故事。
words.en: A means of communication that involves speaking rather than writing or other forms of non-verbal communication.

words.tr: phrase. 有效地且彻底地；充分而完整地
words.ex: He solved the problem effectively and completely.
words.ex_cn: 他有效且彻底地解决了这个问题。
words.en: In a way that achieves the intended result and covers all necessary aspects without omission.

words.tr: adj. 声音的；语音的
words.ex: He learns phonic rules to read words.
words.ex_cn: 他学习语音规则来认读单词。
words.en: Phonic means relating to sound or to the sounds of speech.

words.tr: phrase. 语法和词汇
words.ex: He practices grammar and vocabulary every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习语法和词汇。
words.en: The system of rules and the words available for constructing sentences and expressing ideas in a language.

words.tr: n. 标点符号
words.ex: He forgot the punctuation in his sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记在句子中加标点符号了。
words.en: Punctuation refers to the marks used in writing to separate sentences and their elements and to clarify meaning.

words.tr: v. 忽略；不理会；“ignore”的过去分词；
words.ex: He ignored the message and kept walking.
words.ex_cn: 他忽略了那条消息，继续走。
words.en: If you ignore someone or something, you pay no attention to them.

words.tr: n. 发音；
words.ex: His pronunciation of English words is very clear.
words.ex_cn: 他英语单词的发音非常清晰。
words.en: The way in which a word or a language is spoken.

words.tr: adj. 基于时间的；以时间为基础的
words.ex: He uses a time-based schedule to finish his work.
words.ex_cn: 他使用基于时间的计划来完成工作。
words.en: Relating to or depending on time.

words.tr: n. 计划；规划； v. 计划；打算；“plan”的现在分词；
words.ex: The planning for the trip took a week.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的计划花了一周时间。
words.en: The process of making plans for something.

words.tr: phrase. 面部表情；脸上的神情变化，用以表达情绪或感觉
words.ex: He read her facial expressions to know how she felt.
words.ex_cn: 他通过她的面部表情来了解她的感受。
words.en: The movement or positioning of the facial muscles to communicate emotions or reactions.

words.tr: n. 方言；地方话；
