words.ex: He speaks a local dialect in his village.
words.ex_cn: 他在村子里说一种地方方言。
words.en: A dialect is a form of a language that is spoken in a particular area and that uses some of its own words, grammar, and pronunciations.

words.tr: adv. 同样地；平等地；
words.ex: They equally share the housework.
words.ex_cn: 他们同样分担家务。
words.en: In a manner that is the same in amount, degree, or value.

words.tr: phrase. 尊重该语言；对该语言保持敬意
words.ex: He respects the language by speaking it correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他通过正确使用这种语言来尊重它。
words.en: To treat a language with consideration, following its established rules and conventions.

words.tr:
v. 包括；遮盖；报道；
n. 遮盖物；庇护所；封面；
words.ex: The book covers basic math and science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包括基础数学和科学。
words.en: If something covers something else, it has been placed over or upon it, usually in order to protect it or hide it.

words.tr:
n. 触摸；触觉；触感；
v. 触摸；接触；触动；
words.ex: The touch of her hand was gentle.
words.ex_cn: 她手的触摸很温柔。
words.en: If you touch something, you feel it with your hand, or come into physical contact with it.

words.tr: phrase. 匹配质量；配对品质；相符程度
words.ex: The matching quality of the two shoes is very good.
words.ex_cn: 这两只鞋的匹配质量很好。
words.en: The degree to which two or more things are similar or equal in standard or excellence.

words.tr: n. 个体；个人；“individual”的复数；
words.ex: Each individuals has unique thoughts.
words.ex_cn: 每个个体都有独特的想法。
words.en: Individuals are single human beings as distinct from a group, class, or family.

words.tr: adj. 正式的；正规的；
words.ex: He wore a formal suit to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一套正式的西装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is formal is done or said according to an established or conventional way, especially in an official or serious situation.

words.tr: v. 安排；排列；
words.ex: I will arrange a meeting for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我将为明天安排一次会议。
words.en: If you arrange an event or meeting, you make plans for it to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 电子邮件地址（用于发送和接收电子邮件的电子邮箱地址）
words.ex: He wrote down the e-mail addresses of his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他写下了朋友们的电子邮件地址。
words.en: A series of characters identifying a user's electronic mailbox, used to send and receive messages over the internet.

words.tr: n. 空地；空间；空白；“space”的复数；
words.ex: The children play in the open spaces.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在空地上玩耍。
words.en: Spaces refer to the areas that are empty or available for use, or the distances between things.

words.tr: phrase. （信件中的）内地址，指收信人的姓名和地址，通常位于信纸左上角或信封内侧
words.ex: He wrote the inside address on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他在信封上写了收件人地址。
words.en: The inside address is the recipient's address printed on a letter or document, typically placed at the top left corner of the document.

words.tr: phrase. 问候语；称呼语；致意
words.ex: He wrote a polite salutation at the beginning of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他在信的开头写了一个礼貌的问候语。
words.en: A salutation is a gesture or utterance made as a greeting or acknowledgment of another's arrival or departure.

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.tr: phrase. 特效
words.ex: The movie has amazing special effects.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影有惊人的特效。
words.en: Special effects are unusual pictures or sounds that are created for films and television by using special techniques.

words.tr: n. 签名
words.ex: He signed his name with a clear signature.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的签名签了名字。
words.en: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or letter.

words.tr: phrase. 提供副本；供应复制品
words.ex: He is supplying copies of the report to the team.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向团队提供报告的副本。
words.en: To provide or make available copies of something to someone or for a particular use.

words.tr: n. 圈占地；圈占( enclosure的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The farmers built enclosures for their sheep.
words.ex_cn: 农民们为他们的羊建造了圈占地。
words.en: An enclosure is an area that is surrounded by a barrier or a fence, or something that is sent along with a letter or document.

words.tr: phrase. 奇怪的或花哨的
words.ex: He wore a weird or fancy hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪或花哨的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: Unusual, strange, or excessively ornate in style.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.tr: adj. 熟悉的
words.ex: I am familiar with this song.
words.ex_cn: 我熟悉这首歌。
words.en: If someone or something is familiar to you, you recognize them or know them well.

words.tr: n. 目标；“objective”的复数；
words.ex: His objectives are to learn English and find a good job.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是学好英语并找到一份好工作。
words.en: An objective is something you plan to achieve, especially in business or politics.

words.tr: v.[医]补
words.ex: He is supplementing his income with part-time work.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用兼职工作来补充收入。
words.en: To supplement something means to add something to it in order to make it larger or better.

words.tr: v. 选择；挑选； n. 选择（法） v. 选择，挑选( select的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is selecting a book from the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他正在从书架上选择一本书。
words.en: The act of choosing someone or something from a group.

words.tr: n. 出版商；出版公司；出版社（publisher 的复数）；
words.ex: The publishers released a new book last month.
words.ex_cn: 出版商上个月发布了一本新书。
words.en: Publishers are companies or individuals that prepare and issue books, journals, or music for sale.

words.tr: phrase. 文学手法；修辞手法（指作者在写作中用来增强表达效果、营造意境或传达深层含义的各种技巧，如比喻、象征、反讽等）
words.ex: The poet uses literary devices to make the poem more powerful.
words.ex_cn: 诗人使用文学手法使诗歌更有感染力。
words.en: Literary devices are techniques that writers use to express their ideas and enhance their writing. These include metaphor, simile, irony, and symbolism, among others.

words.tr: n.插图
words.ex: The book has many illustrations to help children understand.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有很多插图来帮助孩子理解。
words.en: Illustrations are pictures or diagrams that are used to explain or decorate a book, magazine, or other text.

words.tr: phrase. 社会技能
words.ex: He is improving his social skills at work.
words.ex_cn: 他正在工作中提升自己的社交技能。
words.en: Social skills are the skills we use to communicate and interact with each other, both verbally and non-verbally, through gestures, body language and our personal appearance.

words.tr: phrase. 具体的结果；实在的成果
words.ex: The meeting led to a concrete outcome.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议取得了具体的成果。
words.en: A concrete outcome is a specific result or conclusion that is clearly defined and measurable.

words.tr: n. 评估；评价；
words.ex: The teacher gave an evaluation of the student's work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了评估。
words.en: An evaluation is a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is.

words.tr: phrase. 宽容与种族主义
words.ex: He showed tolerance and rejected racism.
words.ex_cn: 他表现出宽容，拒绝了种族主义。
words.en: Tolerance refers to the willingness to accept or tolerate, especially opinions or behavior that one may not agree with. Racism is the belief that different races possess distinct characteristics, abilities, or qualities, especially so as to distinguish them as inferior or superior to one another.

words.tr: n. 信心；信任；
words.ex: He spoke with confidence during the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲时充满信心。
words.en: Confidence is a feeling of self-assurance arising from one's appreciation of one's own abilities or qualities.

words.tr: phrase. 支撑材料；辅助材料（用于支撑、辅助或增强主要结构或内容的材料）
words.ex: The support material helps students understand the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 辅助材料帮助学生理解课程。
words.en: Material used to provide support or reinforcement in construction or other applications.

words.tr:
adj. 专业的；职业的；
n. 专业人士；
words.ex: He is a professional teacher with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有多年经验的专业教师。
words.en: A professional is a person who has a job that requires special training and education, especially one that involves a high level of skill or knowledge.

words.tr: phrase. 工作表与活动（通常指教学或学习中使用的练习材料和互动项目）
words.ex: The teacher gave the students worksheets and activities to practice math.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了学生练习数学的练习纸和活动。
words.en: Educational materials designed for practice and application of knowledge, often involving written exercises and tasks.

words.tr: phrase. 价值与用途；指某物的重要性及其实际应用或功能
words.ex: The value and uses of this tool are clear to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具的价值和用途对每个人都很清楚。
words.en: The worth, importance, or practical applications of something.

words.tr: n. 抵抗；阻力；
words.ex: The people showed resistance against the unfair law.
words.ex_cn: 人们对这项不公平的法律表示抵抗。
words.en: Resistance is the refusal to accept or comply with something; the attempt to prevent something by action or argument.

words.tr: n. 丰富；充实；浓缩；富集
words.ex: The school offers enrichment activities for gifted students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为天才学生提供拓展活动。
words.en: The act of improving or enhancing the quality or value of something.

words.tr: n. 环境；环境，[计]上下文（context 复数）；
words.ex: The meaning of a word can change in different contexts.
words.ex_cn: 一个词在不同的环境中意思可能不同。
words.en: The circumstances that form the setting for an event, statement, or idea, and in terms of which it can be fully understood and assessed.

words.tr: adj. 自然主义的；写实主义的；
words.ex: The painting has a naturalistic style, showing trees and animals as they really look.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画具有自然主义风格，真实地描绘了树木和动物。
words.en: Naturalistic describes something that is made or done in a way that is very similar to nature.

words.tr: adj. 值得做的
words.ex: It is worthwhile to learn a new language.
words.ex_cn: 学习一门新语言是值得的。
words.en: If something is worthwhile, it is enjoyable or useful enough to make the effort or money spent on it seem reasonable.

words.tr: v. 利用（…为自己谋利）；开采；开采( exploit的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is exploiting his friends to get free meals.
words.ex_cn: 他正在利用朋友为自己免费吃饭。
words.en: If someone exploits a situation, they use it to gain an advantage for themselves, often unfairly or dishonestly.

words.tr: adj. 分析的；善于分析的；
words.ex: He uses analytical skills to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用分析能力解决数学问题。
words.en: An analytical way of doing something involves the use of logical reasoning.

words.tr: n. 工具；刀具；器具；
words.ex: A hammer is a useful tool for fixing things.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是修理东西的有用工具。
words.en: A tool is any instrument or simple piece of equipment that you hold in your hands and use to do a particular kind of work.

words.tr: phrase. 学习者的任务
words.ex: The teacher gives simple learners' tasks to help them understand better.
words.ex_cn: 老师布置简单的学习任务来帮助学生更好地理解。
words.en: Tasks assigned to learners to facilitate their learning process.

words.tr: n. 热身；准备动作；变暖；加热
words.ex: He does a warm-up before running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步前做热身。
words.en: A warm-up is a period of gentle exercise that you do to prepare your body for a more vigorous activity.

words.tr: n. 图画；照片；“picture”的复数；
words.ex: The children drew colorful pictures on paper.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在纸上画了五颜六色的图画。
words.en: A picture is a visual representation of something, such as a photograph, drawing, or painting.

words.tr: v. 嵌入；插入； adj. 插入的；嵌入的；附着的；插入( insert的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He inserted a coin into the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他把一枚硬币嵌入机器中。
words.en: If you insert an object into something, you put the object inside it.

words.tr: n. 理解；领悟；
words.ex: His comprehension of the story was very good.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个故事的理解很好。
words.en: Comprehension is the ability to understand something.

words.tr: n. 反应；响应；答复；
words.ex: His response to the question was quick.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题的反应很快。
words.en: A reaction to a situation or event.

words.tr: n. 背景；经历；
words.ex: He changed his job because of his background.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的背景换了工作。
words.en: The background is the situation that exists at a particular time, or the situation in which something happens, which helps to explain it.

words.tr: phrase. 详细地
words.ex: He explained the plan in detail.
words.ex_cn: 他详细地解释了这个计划。
words.en: Including all the facts or aspects of a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 最强项；最突出的优点
words.ex: His strongest points are honesty and hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他最大的优点是诚实和努力。
words.en: The most powerful or effective aspects or qualities of something.

words.tr: n. 位置；职位；地位；姿势；
words.ex: The book is on the table in a good position.
words.ex_cn: 书放在桌子上的一个好位置。
words.en: A position refers to the place or type of role someone has in a situation, organization, or society, or the way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.

words.tr: v. 重述；
words.ex: He restate the main idea in simpler words.
words.ex_cn: 他用更简单的语言重述了主要观点。
words.en: If you restate something, you say it again or in a different way.

words.tr: phrase. 熟悉，通晓
words.ex: He is familiar with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: Having a good knowledge of or being well acquainted with something or someone.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；“source”的复数；
words.ex: Water comes from natural sources like rivers and rain.
words.ex_cn: 水来自河流和雨水等自然来源。
words.en: Sources refer to the origins or places from which something comes or is obtained. They can be people, books, documents, etc., that provide information.

words.tr: n.图书馆
words.ex: He goes to libraries to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他去图书馆读书。
words.en: A place where books, magazines, and other materials (such as videos and musical recordings) are available for people to use or borrow.

words.tr: phrase. 初级的与次级的；主要的与次要的；基础与进阶的
words.ex: He teaches primary and secondary math in a public school.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所公立学校教小学和中学数学。
words.en: The main or most important type and the next level of importance or detail.

words.tr: adj. 组织良好的
words.ex: He is a well-organized student.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有条理的学生。
words.en: Arranged or structured in an efficient and effective way.

words.tr: n. 证据；
words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 令人信服的观点；有说服力的论点
words.ex: He made some convincing points in the debate.
words.ex_cn: 他在辩论中提出了一些有说服力的观点。
words.en: Arguments or facts that effectively persuade someone of a particular viewpoint.

words.tr: phrase. 一个概要；提纲；轮廓
words.ex: He wrote an outline for his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的文章写了一个提纲。
words.en: A structured plan or summary of the main points of a topic, speech, or document.

words.tr: phrase. 单一句子；一个独立完整的句子
words.ex: He wrote a single sentence to explain the idea.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一个单一的句子来解释这个想法。
words.en: A complete grammatical unit expressing a statement, question, or command.

words.tr: phrase. 简要的总结；简短的概述
words.ex: He gave a brief summary of the story.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个故事做了简要的总结。
words.en: A short, condensed account of the most important points.

words.tr: phrase. 安全话题；不会冒犯他人或引起争议的话题
words.ex: He chose safe subjects for his exam.
words.ex_cn: 他为考试选择了稳妥的科目。
words.en: Topics that are unlikely to cause offense or controversy, often used in conversation to maintain harmony.

words.tr: phrase. 两极分化且分裂的；对立且分化的
words.ex: The two groups are polarized and divided over the new law.
words.ex_cn: 这两个群体因这项新法律而观点对立且分裂。
words.en: Characterized by strong, opposing opinions or a clear division between two sides.

words.tr: v. 阻碍，妨碍( hinder的第三人称单数 )
words.ex: Lack of sleep hinders his ability to focus.
words.ex_cn: 睡眠不足妨碍他集中注意力。
words.en: If something hinders you, it makes it more difficult for you to do something or make progress.

words.tr:
n. 头脑；意向；心；智力；
v. 介意；注意；
words.ex: He lost his mind after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了理智。
words.en: Your mind is your ability to think and reason. If you mind something, you are bothered by it or you object to it.

words.tr: n. 脑；脑力；智力；
words.ex: The brain controls our thoughts and movements.
words.ex_cn: 大脑控制我们的思想和行动。
words.en: The brain is the organ inside your head that controls your body's activities and enables you to think and to feel things such as heat and pain.

words.tr: phrase. 使用开放式问题（指鼓励详细回答、不限定选项的提问方式）
words.ex: He uses open-ended questions to learn more.
words.ex_cn: 他使用开放式问题来了解更多。
words.en: To ask questions that encourage detailed, explanatory answers rather than simple yes/no responses.

words.tr: adj. 复杂的
words.ex: The math problem is complicated.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题很复杂。
words.en: Involving many different and confusing aspects.

words.tr: n. 分心；干扰；
words.ex: Phone notifications are common distractions while studying.
words.ex_cn: 手机通知是学习时常见的分心因素。
words.en: Something that prevents someone from concentrating on something else.

words.tr: phrase. 无关的想法；不相关的思想
words.ex: He had unrelated thoughts during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间想到了一些不相关的事情。
words.en: Ideas or reflections that are not connected to the main topic or subject being discussed.

words.tr: v. 承认；
words.ex: He finally admit his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, you agree, often unwillingly, that it is true.

words.tr: phrase. 对……小心的；注意……的
words.ex: He is careful about eating too much sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他很注意不要吃太多糖。
words.en: Cautious or mindful of potential issues or risks in a particular situation.

words.tr:
n. 个人；
adj. 个别的；单独的；
words.ex: Each individual has the right to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有权自由发言。
words.en: An individual is a person considered separately from their society or community. As an adjective, it describes something that is single, separate, or unique to a person or thing.

words.tr: adj. 无聊的；令人厌倦的； v. “bore”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie was boring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很无聊。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as boring, you mean that they are not interesting and make you feel tired or impatient.

words.tr: v. 听
words.ex: He listens to music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听音乐。
words.en: If you listen to someone or something, you give your attention to a sound or to what someone says.

words.tr: phrase. 处于控制之中；掌握局势；能控制局面
words.ex: He is in control of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他掌控着这辆车。
words.en: Having the power to influence or direct people's behavior or the course of events.

words.tr: phrase. 比……更慢的
words.ex: The turtle moves slower than the rabbit.
words.ex_cn: 乌龟的移动比兔子慢。
words.en: Moving or progressing at a reduced speed compared to something else.

words.tr: phrase. 在适当的长度上；以合适的长度
words.ex: He explained the idea at appropriate length.
words.ex_cn: 他适当地详细解释了这个想法。
words.en: Having a suitable or fitting length for its purpose or context.

words.tr: n. 对话；对话( dialogue的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The children read simple dialogues in their English book.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在英语课本中阅读简单的对话。
words.en: A dialogue is a conversation between two or more people in a book, play, or film.

words.tr: phrase. 想法与洞见；创意与深刻见解
words.ex: He shared his ideas and insight about the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他分享了他对这个问题的想法和见解。
words.en: Thoughts, concepts, and deeper understanding gained from experience or reflection.

words.tr: phrase. 时事；当前发生的重大事件
words.ex: He reads the newspaper to learn about current affairs.
words.ex_cn: 他读报纸来了解时事。
words.en: Current affairs are events of political or social importance and interest happening in the world at the present time.

words.tr: phrase. 名字或职业；姓名或工作
words.ex: He wrote down the names or jobs of all the people at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他记下了会议上所有人的名字或职业。
words.en: Personal identifiers such as given names or occupational titles.

words.tr: phrase. 构造句子；组句
words.ex: He can frame sentences correctly in English now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在能用英语正确地造句了。
words.en: Sentences that provide a grammatical or contextual example for a word or phrase.

words.tr: 短语. 靠近你；在你附近
words.ex: He stands close to you when he talks.
words.ex_cn: 他说话时站在你旁边。
words.en: Physically or emotionally near to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 闲聊；寒暄；无关紧要的谈话
words.ex: He makes small talk with his neighbors every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上和邻居闲聊。
words.en: Small talk is polite conversation about unimportant or uncontroversial matters, especially as engaged in on social occasions.

words.tr: n. 雄辩；口才
words.ex: His eloquence moved everyone in the room.
words.ex_cn: 他的雄辩打动了房间里每一个人。
words.en: The ability to speak or write in a way that is fluent, persuasive, and expressive.

words.tr: phrase. 心智与耳朵；注意力与听觉（指同时调动思考与聆听的状态）
words.ex: He uses his mind and ears to listen carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他用头脑和耳朵仔细听。
words.en: The ability to listen attentively and understand carefully.

words.tr: n. 作口译的人
words.ex: He is an interpreter for the United Nations.
words.ex_cn: 他是联合国的口译员。
words.en: An interpreter is a person whose job is to translate what someone is saying into another language, especially in a situation where people are speaking different languages.

words.tr: phrase. 说英语
words.ex: He speaks English every day at work.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在工作中说英语。
words.en: Use the English language in verbal communication.

words.tr: phrase. 纠正你；改正你的错误
words.ex: I will correct you if you make a mistake.
words.ex_cn: 如果你出错，我会纠正你。
words.en: To point out someone's errors in speech or writing.

words.tr: phrase. 感到尴尬的；觉得难为情的
words.ex: He feels embarrassed when he makes a mistake in class.
words.ex_cn: 当他在课堂上犯错时，他感到尴尬。
words.en: To feel uncomfortable or self-conscious because of one's actions, appearance, or a situation.

words.tr: n. 态度；姿势（复数形式）；
words.ex: His attitudes toward homework are very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, especially as shown by your behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 自信且充满热情的
words.ex: She is confident and passionate about teaching math.
words.ex_cn: 她对教数学充满自信和热情。
words.en: Feeling or showing confidence and strong enthusiasm.

words.tr: 名词短语，更好的信息；更准确或更全面的情报或资料
words.ex: He needs better information to make a decision.
words.ex_cn: 他需要更好的信息来做决定。
words.en: More accurate or useful details or data.

words.tr: adj. 根据事实的；真实的；
words.ex: His report is factual and accurate.
words.ex_cn: 他的报告是基于事实且准确的。
words.en: If something is factual, it is based on facts or concerns facts.

words.tr: phrase. 得出结论；结束；推断出
words.ex: He will conclude the meeting with a summary.
words.ex_cn: 他将以一个总结来结束会议。
words.en: To bring something to an end or reach a decision after considering the facts.

words.tr: v. 错放；“misplace”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He misplaced his keys on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙错放在桌子上。
words.en: If you describe a feeling or action as misplaced, you are critical of it because you think it is inappropriate, or directed towards the wrong thing or person.

words.tr: n. 情感；感觉；“feeling”的复数；
words.ex: He ignored her feelings and left without saying goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他忽视了她的情感，没有说再见就离开了。
words.en: Feelings are the emotions that you have, such as joy, sadness, or anger.

words.tr: n. 细节；“detail”的复数； v. 详细说明；
words.ex: Can you give me the details of the meeting?
words.ex_cn: 你能给我会议的细节吗？
words.en: The word 'details' refers to the individual facts or elements that make up a larger whole. It is often used to describe the specific aspects or components of a subject that are important for understanding it fully.

words.tr:
n. 要点；点；观点；分数；
v. 指出；指向；
words.ex: The main point of his speech was to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 他演讲的主要要点是节约能源。
words.en: A point is a particular place or position, or a detail or aspect of something. It can also refer to the sharp end of something, or a unit of scoring in games. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending a finger or other object.

words.tr: n. 侦探( detective的名词复数 )
words.ex: The detectives found the clue quickly.
words.ex_cn: 侦探们很快找到了线索。
words.en: A detective is someone whose job is to discover what has happened in a crime or other situation and to find the people involved.

words.tr: phrase. 增强信心；提高自信
words.ex: He practices every day to increase the confidence.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习以增强信心。
words.en: To boost someone's self-assurance or certainty.

words.tr: phrase. 刨根问底的问题；深入探究的提问
words.ex: The teacher asked probing questions to understand the students' thoughts.
words.ex_cn: 老师提出了深入的问题，以了解学生的想法。
words.en: Questions that are intended to make someone think deeply about something, often used to get detailed information or to challenge someone's ideas or statements.

words.tr: phrase. 获得澄清；弄清楚；使明确
words.ex: He asked a question to gain clarification about the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他问了一个问题以弄清楚作业的要求。
words.en: To obtain a clearer understanding or explanation of something.

words.tr: phrase. 个人的恳求；私人呼吁
words.ex: He made a personal appeal for help.
words.ex_cn: 他亲自恳求帮助。
words.en: A request or statement that is personal and often emotional.

words.tr: phrase. 预期的答案；期望的回答
words.ex: The teacher wrote the expected answer on the board.
words.ex_cn: 老师把预期的答案写在了黑板上。
words.en: The response that is anticipated or most likely to occur.

words.tr: adj. 修辞性的；词藻华丽的；反问的
words.ex: He asked a rhetorical question to make a point.
words.ex_cn: 他问了一个修辞性的问题来阐明观点。
words.en: A rhetorical question is one which is asked in order to make a statement rather than to get an answer.

words.tr: v. 参与；从事；吸引；与…建立密切关系；
words.ex: He engages in community volunteer work.
words.ex_cn: 他参与社区志愿工作。
words.en: To engage means to occupy, attract, or involve someone or oneself in a particular activity or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 有创造力的或富有艺术性的
words.ex: He is creative and loves to paint.
words.ex_cn: 他很有创造力，喜欢画画。
words.en: Relating to imagination, originality, or the arts.

words.tr: phrase. 审美满足；对美的感受或体验所带来的心理愉悦
words.ex: She feels aesthetic satisfaction when she paints a beautiful picture.
words.ex_cn: 当她画出一幅美丽的画时，她感到审美上的满足。
words.en: Aesthetic satisfaction refers to the pleasure or fulfillment one gets from the beauty or artistic qualities of something.

words.tr: adv. 深刻地；
words.ex: He was profoundly moved by the music.
words.ex_cn: 他被音乐深深打动了。
words.en: In a profound manner; deeply.

words.tr: adj. 结构化的；有条理的； v. “structure”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The teacher gave a structured plan for the project.
words.ex_cn: 老师为这个项目提供了一个结构化的计划。
words.en: Arranged in a clear, organized way, often with a particular pattern or system.

words.tr: adj. 使感动的；感情的；动感情的
words.ex: The movie used emotive music to make people cry.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影用了富有情感的音乐来让人流泪。
words.en: If you describe something as emotive, you mean that it is concerned with emotions and feelings, and often causes them.

words.tr: n. 设备；装置；“device”的复数；
words.ex: The school bought new devices for the students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生们购买了新的设备。
words.en: A device is an object that has been invented for a particular purpose, for example for recording or measuring something.

words.tr: n. 反应；响应；答复；
words.ex: His response to the question was quick.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题的反应很快。
words.en: A reaction to a situation or event.

words.tr: n.主题
words.ex: The book has many themes about friendship and courage.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有许多关于友谊和勇气的主题。
words.en: Themes are the main subjects or ideas that are discussed in a piece of writing, movie, or work of art, or that are explored in a discussion or debate.

words.tr: phrase. 他自己的经历；他个人的经验
words.ex: He learned from his own experience.
words.ex_cn: 他从自己的经历中学习。
words.en: Personal knowledge or skill gained through direct participation in events or activities.

words.tr: phrase. 个人动机；自我驱动力；促使个人行动或努力的内在动力
words.ex: His personal motivation is to work harder for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他的个人动力是为家人更加努力工作。
words.en: Personal motivation refers to the internal drive that pushes an individual to achieve goals or pursue interests, often stemming from personal desires, values, or needs.

words.tr: phrase. 美丽的事物；美好的东西
words.ex: Things of beauty bring joy every day.
words.ex_cn: 美丽的事物每天带来快乐。
words.en: Objects, artworks, or natural phenomena that are aesthetically pleasing or evoke admiration.

words.tr: n.冲突
words.ex: The two brothers have many conflicts.
words.ex_cn: 这两个兄弟有很多冲突。
words.en: A conflict is a serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.

words.tr: phrase. 科幻作品
words.ex: He likes to read science fiction books.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Science fiction is a genre of speculative fiction that typically deals with imaginative and futuristic concepts such as advanced science and technology, space exploration, time travel, parallel universes, and extraterrestrial life. It has been called the 'literature of ideas', and often explores the potential consequences of scientific, social, and technological innovations.

words.tr: n. 严重性；
words.ex: The seriousness of the accident surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故的严重性让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: The quality or state of being serious.

words.tr: n.读者
words.ex: The readers enjoy the new book.
words.ex_cn: 读者们喜欢这本新书。
words.en: People who read, especially those who read a particular book, magazine, or newspaper.

words.tr: phrase. 五个世纪
words.ex: The building stood for five centuries.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑屹立了五个世纪。
words.en: A period of five hundred years.

words.tr: adj. 普遍的；全体的；
words.ex: This rule is universal for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则对所有学生都是普遍适用的。
words.en: Something that is universal affects or relates to every part of the world or the universe.

words.tr: phrase. 中世纪英语文学（约公元1100–1500年间用中古英语创作的文学作品，包括乔叟《坎特伯雷故事集》等）
words.ex: He reads middle english literature at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学里读中古英语文学。
words.en: Literature written in the Middle English language, which was used from the late 11th century to the late 15th century.

words.tr: phrase. 讲故事的朝圣者（复数）
words.ex: The storytelling pilgrims shared old tales by the campfire.
words.ex_cn: 这些讲故事的朝圣者在篝火旁分享了古老的故事。
words.en: Travelers on a journey to a sacred place who share or recount narratives.

words.tr: phrase. 朝圣者讲故事；朝圣者讲述的故事
words.ex: The pilgrims are telling stories around the campfire.
words.ex_cn: 朝圣者们正在篝火旁讲故事。
words.en: Individuals on a religious or spiritual journey who are sharing stories or tales.

words.tr:
adj. 未知的；不为人知的；
n. 未知的地方（或事物）；
words.ex: The unknown cause of the accident is being investigated.
words.ex_cn: 事故的未知原因正在调查中。
words.en: If something is unknown, it is not known or recognized by people.

words.tr: phrase. 《圣经》；基督教经典，包含旧约和新约
words.ex: He reads the bible every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读《圣经》。
words.en: The Bible is the sacred scriptures of Christianity, comprising the Old Testament and the New Testament.

words.tr: phrase. 成为……的国王；统治……
words.ex: He became king of England in 1216.
words.ex_cn: 他在1216年成为英格兰国王。
words.en: To assume the position or role of a ruler or leader of a nation or group.

words.tr: phrase. 占上风；在…中占优势；在…中占主导地位
words.ex: Honesty prevailed over deceit in the end.
words.ex_cn: 最终，诚实占了上风。
words.en: To have been the dominant or most powerful force in a situation or conflict.

words.tr: phrase. + adj. 广泛被欣赏的；普遍受到赞赏的
words.ex: This song is widely appreciated by older people.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌受到老年人的广泛喜爱。
words.en: Recognized and valued by many people.

words.tr: phrase. 广受欢迎的；广泛流行的
words.ex: This song is widely popular among teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在青少年中非常流行。
words.en: Liked or enjoyed by a large number of people.

words.tr: phrase. 宗教的且浪漫的；虔诚的且富有浪漫色彩的
words.ex: He wrote a religious and romantic poem about love and faith.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一首关于爱与信仰的宗教且浪漫的诗。
words.en: Pertaining to both faith-based beliefs and emotional, idealistic sentiments.

words.tr: adj. 富有想象力的；充满意象的
words.ex: The poet wrote an imagery-rich description of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这位诗人写了一段富有想象力的日落描述。
words.en: adj. Containing a lot of imagery, which is the use of vivid or figurative language to represent objects, actions, or ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 传统价值观；指社会长期传承的道德、文化或行为准则
words.ex: He follows traditional values from his family.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循家人传承的传统价值观。
words.en: Traditional values refer to the beliefs, customs, and practices that have been passed down from generation to generation within a society or culture.

words.tr: phrase. 现实感；对真实性的感受
words.ex: The movie gave him a feeling of realism.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影给了他一种真实感。
words.en: A sense or perception of accuracy and truthfulness in representing reality.

words.tr: adj. 讽刺的；挖苦的
words.ex: The cartoon is satirical and makes fun of politicians.
words.ex_cn: 这幅漫画是讽刺性的，嘲笑政客。
words.en: A satirical piece of writing or speech uses satire to criticize people or ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 被引用最多的；最常引用的
words.ex: He is the most quoted scientist in the news.
words.ex_cn: 他是新闻中最常被引用的科学家。
words.en: Frequently cited or referenced in texts, speeches, or discussions.
